קִיבֵּל: קִבֵּל — to receive (Piel pf. 3ms); 'received'. In Avot the technical verb of the chain of tradition
מִסִּינַיִ: מִ + סִינַי — Sinai, with mi-, 'from'; 'from Sinai'. Kaufmann's final yod carries a ḥiriq: read mi-Sinay
וּמְסָרָהּ: וּ + מָסַר + ־הּ — masar, to hand over, transmit (Qal pf. 3ms + 3fs suffix -ah); 'and handed it on'
לִיהוֹשֻׁעַ: לְ + יְהוֹשֻׁעַ — Yehoshua, Joshua (proper name), with li-, 'to'; 'to Joshua'
וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ: וִ + יְהוֹשֻׁעַ — 'and Joshua' (u-/vi- 'and' before yod becomes vi-)
לִזְקֵנִים: לִ + זְקֵנִים — zaken, elder (m. pl.); 'to the elders' — the leaders after Joshua (Judg 2:7)
לִנְבִיאִים: לִ + נְבִיאִים — navi, prophet (m. pl.); 'to the prophets'
מְסָרוּהָ: מָסַר + ־הָ — masar, to hand over (Qal pf. 3mpl + 3fs suffix); 'handed it on'
לְאַנְשֵׁי: לְ + אַנְשֵׁי — anshei, men of (construct pl. of ish, man); 'to the men of'
כְנֶסֶת: כְּנֶסֶת — assembly, gathering (f.; construct with the next word)
בַּדִּין: בְּ + הַ + דִּין — din, judgment, law, lawsuit (m.); 'in judgment'
וְהַעֲמִידוּ: וְ + הֶעֱמִיד — he'emid, to set up, raise up (Hifil imperative mpl); 'and raise up'. Kaufmann vocalizes the he with pataḥ
וַעֲשׂוּ: וַ + עָשָׂה — asa, to do, make (Qal imperative mpl); 'and make'
סִיַיג: סְיָג — fence (m.); 'a fence'. Kaufmann: siyyag, with doubled yod
לַתּוֹרָה: לְ + הַ + תּוֹרָה — 'for the Torah, around the Torah'
הַצַדִּיק: הַ + צַדִּיק — tsaddik, righteous man (m.); 'the Righteous'. Kaufmann has no dagesh in the tsade here
הַגְּדוֹלָה: הַ + גְּדוֹלָה — 'the Great' (as above, with the dagesh written)
הוּא: הוּא — he (pron. 3ms); with הָיָה אוֹמֵר, 'he used to say'
אוֹ׳: אוֹמֵר (abbr.) — omer, saying (Qal participle ms); written אוֹ׳, abbreviated by the scribe. הוּא הָיָה אוֹמֵר = 'he used to say'
עַל: עַל — on, upon; here 'on (which the world stands)'
שְׁלֹשָה: שְׁלֹשָׁה — three (spelled here without the second shin dot)
הָעֲבֹדָה: הָ + עֲבוֹדָה — avoda, service, worship (f.); here the Temple service
גְּמִילוּת: גְּמִילוּת — gemilut, the doing, bestowing of (f. construct); with ḥasadim, 'acts of kindness'
חֲסָדִים: חֶסֶד — kindness, loving-kindness (m. pl.); gemilut ḥasadim, 'the doing of kindnesses'
אַנְטִיגִנַס: אַנְטִיגְנוֹס — Antigonos (Greek proper name); Kaufmann spells it Antiginas
אִישׁ: אִישׁ — man; before a place name, 'man of', i.e. from
אוֹמֵ׳: אוֹמֵר (abbr.) — omer, saying (Qal participle ms), written אוֹמֵ׳
אַל: אַל — do not (negation with a jussive/imperfect)
תִּהְיוּ: הָיָה — to be (Qal impf. 2mpl); with אַל, 'do not be'
כַעֲבָדִים: כְּ + עֶבֶד — eved, slave, servant (m. pl.); 'like slaves'
הַמְּשַׁמְּשִׁים: הַ + שִׁמֵּשׁ — shimesh, to serve, attend (Piel participle mpl); 'who serve'
הָרָב: הָ + רַב — rav, master (m.); 'the master'. Here the slave's owner, not a teacher
מְנַת: מְנָת — portion; עַל מְנָת, 'on condition, for the purpose of'
לְקַבֵּל: לְ + קִבֵּל — to receive (Piel inf.); 'to receive'
פְּרַס: פְּרָס — portion, reward; a payment in kind (m.)
הַמְשַׁמְּשִׁים: הַ + שִׁמֵּשׁ — 'who serve' (as above, without the dagesh in the mem)
שֶׁלֹּא: שֶׁ + לֹּא — 'that not'; עַל מְנָת שֶׁלֹּא, 'on condition of not'. Kaufmann marks the o of lo with a dot that the transcription records as a shin dot on the lamed
וִיהֵא: וִ + הָיָה — to be (Qal jussive 3ms, Mishnaic יְהֵא); 'and let (it) be'
מוֹרָא: מוֹרָא — fear, awe (m.); מוֹרָא שָׁמַיִם, 'fear of Heaven'
שָׁמַיִם: שָׁמַיִם — heaven, sky; in the Mishnah a reverent name for God: 'Heaven'
יוֹסֵה: יוֹסֵה — Yose (proper name; the printed editions have Yosi)
צְרֵידָה: צְרֵדָה — Tsereda, a town (proper name); Kaufmann: Tsereida
בֵן: בֵּן — son of (spelled with tsere here)
יְרוּשָ׳: יְרוּשָׁלַיִם (abbr.) — Jerusalem, written יְרוּשָׁ׳; אִישׁ יְרוּשָׁלַיִם, 'of Jerusalem'
מִמֶּנּוּ: מִן + ־נּוּ — 'from him'; קִבְּלוּ מִמֶּנּוּ, 'received (the tradition) from him'
וַועַד: וַעַד — meeting, assembly (m.); בֵּית וַעַד, 'a meeting-house'. Kaufmann writes it with a double vav
לַחֲכָמִ׳: לְ + הַ + חֲכָמִים (abbr.) — ḥakham, sage (m. pl.), written לַחֲכָמִ׳; 'for the sages'
וֶהֱוֵוי: וֶ + הֱוֵי — hevei, be! (Mishnaic imperative 2ms of hava, to be; = biblical הֱיֵה); 'and be'. Spelled with double vav
מִתְאַבֵּק: הִתְאַבֵּק — to cover oneself with dust (Hitpael participle ms, from avak, dust); 'sitting in the dust'
בַּעֲפַר: בַּ + עֲפַר — afar, dust (m., construct); 'in the dust of'
רַגְלֵיהֶם: רֶגֶל + ־יהֶם — regel, foot (f. dual/pl.) + 3mpl suffix; 'their feet'
וְשׁוֹתֶה: וְ + שָׁתָה — shata, to drink (Qal participle ms); 'and drinking'
בְצִמְאָה: בְּ + צָמָא — tsama, thirst (Mishnaic tsim'a); 'with thirst, thirstily'
דִּבְרֵיהֶם: דָּבָר + ־יהֶם — davar, word (m. pl. + 3mpl suffix); 'their words'
או׳: אוֹמֵר (abbr.) — omer, saying (Qal participle ms), written או׳
לָרְוָוחָה: לְ + הָ + רְוָחָה — revaḥa, wide space, relief (f.); 'wide open'. Spelled with double vav
וְיהְיוּ: וְ + הָיָה — to be (Qal jussive 3mpl); 'and let (them) be'
בְּנֵי: בֵּן — son (construct pl., 'sons of'); בְּנֵי בֵיתֶךָ, 'members of your household'
תַּרְבֵּה: הִרְבָּה — to do much, multiply (Hifil impf./jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not multiply'
הָאִשָּׁה: הָ + אִשָּׁה — isha, woman, wife (f.); 'the woman'
קַל: קַל — light; קַל וָחוֹמֶר, 'light and heavy' — the a-fortiori argument
וָחוֹמֶר: וָ + חֹמֶר — ḥomer, heavy, weighty (m.); 'and heavy'
בְּאֵשֶׁת: בְּ + אֵשֶׁת — eshet, wife of (construct of isha); 'about the wife of'
חֲבֵירוֹ: חָבֵר + ־וֹ — ḥaver, fellow, neighbor (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'his fellow'
מִכָּן: מִכָּאן — from here; 'hence'. Kaufmann: mi-kan, final nun
חֲכָמִ׳: חֲכָמִים (abbr.) — ḥakhamim, sages (m. pl.), written חֲכָמִ׳
הַמַּרְבֵּה: הַ + מַרְבֶּה — marbe, one who multiplies (Hifil participle ms); 'whoever does much'
כשהיא: כְּשֶׁ + הִיא — 'when she (is)'. Unvocalized in the manuscript, and absent from the printed editions
נידה: נִדָּה — menstruant (f.); a woman in her period of menstrual impurity. Unvocalized in the manuscript
וּבָטֵל: וּ + בָּטֵל — batel, idle, neglecting (adj./participle ms); 'and neglects'
מִדִּבְרֵי: מִ + דִּבְרֵי — divrei, words of (construct pl. of davar); 'from words of'
וְסוֹפוֹ: וְ + סוֹף + ־וֹ — sof, end (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'and his end (is)'
לְגֵיהִנָם: לְ + גֵּיהִנֹּם — Gehinnom, Gehenna, the place of punishment; 'Gehenna'
יְהוֹשֻעַ: יְהוֹשֻׁעַ — Yehoshua (proper name; here without the shin dot on the shin)
פְּרַחְיָיה: פְּרַחְיָה — Peraḥya (proper name); spelled with double yod
וּמַתַּיִי: וּ + מַתַּי — Mattai (proper name; the printed editions have Nittai, נִתַּאי); 'and Mattai'
הָאַרְבְּלִי: הָ + אַרְבֵּלִי — the Arbelite, from Arbel in Galilee (gentilic adj.)
מֵהֶן: מֵ + הֵן — 'from them'. Mishnaic Hebrew often writes final -n for -m: מֵהֶן = מֵהֶם
עֲשֵׂה: עָשָׂה — to do, make (Qal imperative ms); 'make (for yourself)'
וּקְנֵה: וּ + קָנָה — kana, to acquire, buy (Qal imperative ms); 'and acquire'
וֶהֱוִי: וֶ + הֱוֵי — 'and be' (Mishnaic imperative 2ms), here vocalized hevi
דָן: דָּן — judging (Qal participle ms of din, to judge)
הָאָדָן: הָ + אָדָם — adam, person, human being; 'every person'. Kaufmann writes final nun for mem (ha-adan)
לְכַף: לְ + כַף — kaf, palm, pan of a scale; לְכַף זְכוּת, 'toward the scale of merit' — giving the benefit of the doubt
מַתַּיִי: מַתַּי — Mattai (proper name; printed editions: Nittai)
הרְחַק: הַרְחֵק — keep far (Hifil imperative ms). The vocalized letters read the Qal רְחַק, 'keep far'; the he was added unvocalized by a later hand
מִשָּׁכֵן: מִ + שָׁכֵן — shakhen, neighbor (m.); 'from a neighbor'
תִּתְחַבַּר: הִתְחַבֵּר — to associate with (Hitpael impf./jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not associate'
לָרָשָׁע: לְ + הָ + רָשָׁע — rasha, wicked man (m.); 'with the wicked'
תִּתְיוֹאַשׁ: הִתְיָאֵשׁ — to give up hope, despair (Hitpael impf./jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not despair of'. Kaufmann vocalizes tityo'ash
שָׁטָח: שָׁטַח — Shataḥ (proper name), written over an erasure by a second hand
תַּעַשׂ: עָשָׂה — to do, make (Qal jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not make'
כְּעַרְכֵי: כְּ + עוֹרְכֵי — orkhei, arrangers of (Qal participle construct pl. of arakh); 'like those who arrange (the case for)' — advocates who coach a litigant. כְּ added by a second hand
וּכְשֶׁיּיהְיוּ: וּ + כְשֶׁ + הָיָה — 'and when (they) are' (Qal impf. 3mpl); corrected from כשייהוא
בַעֲלֵי: בַּעַל — owner, party (construct pl.); בַּעֲלֵי הַדִּין, 'the parties to the case, the litigants'
עוֹמְדִין: עָמַד — to stand (Qal participle mpl, Mishnaic -in); 'standing'
יְהְיו: הָיָה — to be (Qal jussive 3mpl); 'let them be'. Corrected from יהוא; the vowel under the yod stayed
בְעֵינֶיךָ: בְּ + עֵינַיִם + ־ךָ — einayim, eyes; 'in your eyes'
כָרְשָׁעִים: כְּ + הָ + רְשָׁעִים — 'like the wicked', i.e. as guilty
וּכְשֶׁנִּפְטָרִים: וּ + כְשֶׁ + נִפְטַר — niftar, to take leave, depart (Nifal participle mpl); 'and when they depart'
יְהוּא: הָיָה — to be (Qal jussive 3mpl), spelled יְהוּא — Kaufmann's spelling of יִהְיוּ, left uncorrected here
כַצַדִּיקִים: כְּ + הַ + צַדִּיקִים — 'like the righteous', i.e. as innocent
הֱוִוי: הֱוֵי — be! (Mishnaic imperative 2ms), spelled with double vav
מַרְבֵּה: מַרְבֶּה — doing much (Hifil participle ms); הֱוֵי מַרְבֶּה לַחְקֹר, 'examine thoroughly'
לַחְקוֹר: לַחְקוֹר — to examine, investigate (Qal inf. of ḥakar)
הָעֵדִים: הָ + עֵד — ed, witness (m. pl.); 'the witnesses'
מִתּוֹכָן: מִ + תּוֹךְ + ־ָן — tokh, midst; 'from within them' (Mishnaic -an for -am); 'from them'
יִלְמְדוּ: לָמַד — to learn (Qal impf. 3mpl); 'they will learn'
לְשַׁקֵּר: לְ + שִׁקֵּר — shiker, to lie (Piel inf.); 'to lie'
הַמְּלָאכָה: הַ + מְּלָאכָה — melakha, work, labour, craft (f.)
וּשְׂנָא: וּ + שָׂנֵא — sane, to hate (Qal imperative ms); 'and hate'
הָרַבָּנוּת: הָ + רַבָּנוּת — rabbanut, mastery, lordship, holding authority (f.)
תִּתְוַודַּע: הִתְוַדַּע — to make oneself known (Hitpael impf./jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not make yourself known'. Spelled with double vav
לָרְשׁוּת: לְ + הָ + רְשׁוּת — reshut, authority, the ruling power (f.); 'to the government'. Written over an erasure
הִיזַּהֲרוּ: הִזָּהֵר — to be careful (Nifal imperative mpl); 'be careful!'
תָחוֹבוּ: חָב — to incur (a penalty) (Qal impf. 2mpl, from ḥov); 'you incur'
חוֹבַת: חוֹבָה — liability, penalty (f. construct); חוֹבַת גָּלוּת, 'the penalty of exile'
וְתִיגְלוּ: וְ + גָּלָה — gala, to go into exile (Qal impf. 2mpl); 'and you go into exile'
לִמְקוֹם: לִ + מְקוֹם — makom, place (construct); 'to a place of'
הַמַּיִם: הַ + מַּיִם — mayim, water (m. pl.); 'the waters'. Bad water stands for false teaching
הרעים: הָ + רָעִים — ra, bad, evil (m. pl.); 'the bad'. Unvocalized in the manuscript
וישתו: וְ + שָׁתָה — shata, to drink (Qal impf. 3mpl); 'and (they) drink'. Unvocalized in the manuscript
התלמידים: הַ + תַּלְמִידִים — 'the students'. Unvocalized in the manuscript
הַבָּאִים: הַ + בָּא — ba, coming (Qal participle mpl); 'who come'
וְיַמוּתוּ: וְ + מֵת — met, to die (Qal impf. 3mpl); 'and they die'
וְנִמְצָא: וְ + נִמְצָא — nimtsa, to be found, turn out (Nifal pf. 3ms); 'and it turns out that'
שֵׁם: שֵׁם — name; שֵׁם שָׁמַיִם, 'the name of Heaven', i.e. God's name
מִתְחַלֵּל: מִתְחַלֵּל — mitḥalel, being profaned (Hitpael participle ms of ḥalal)
שֶׁלְּאַהֲרֹן: שֶׁל + אַהֲרֹן — 'of Aaron' — Kaufmann writes של joined to the noun, as the Mishnah usually does
וְרוֹדֵף: וְ + רָדַף — radaf, to pursue (Qal participle ms); 'and pursuing'
הַבְּרִיּוֹת: הַ + בְּרִיּוֹת — beriyot, creatures, people (f. pl. of beriya); 'people'
וּמְקָרְבָן: וּ + קֵרֵב + ־ָן — kerev, to bring near (Piel participle ms) + 3mpl suffix (-an); 'and bringing them near'
נְגַד: נְגַד — Aramaic: to draw out, extend (pf. 3ms, or passive participle); 'made great, spread abroad'
שְׁמָא: שְׁמָא — Aramaic: name, reputation (emphatic state of shum); 'a name'
אָבַד: אָבַד — Aramaic: to be lost, perish (pf. 3ms); 'is lost'
וְדִילָא: וּ + דִּי + לָא — Aramaic: 'and (he) who does not'
מוֹסִיף: מוֹסִיף — mosif, adding (Hebrew Hifil participle ms of yasaf); 'add (to it)'
ייסוּף: סוּף — Aramaic: to come to an end (impf. 3ms); 'will come to an end'. Printed editions: יָסֵיף
יְלִיף: יְלִיף — Aramaic: learning (participle ms of yelaf, 'to learn')
חַיָּיב: חַיָּיב — liable, deserving (adj. ms; Hebrew and Aramaic); קְטָלָא חַיָּב, 'deserves death'. Written over an erasure
יעבד: עֲבַד — Aramaic: to do, make (impf. 3ms). Unvocalized in the manuscript; the clause is absent from the printed editions and its sense is uncertain
קטלה: קְטָלָא — Aramaic: death, killing. Unvocalized in the manuscript
קטלין: קָטְלִין — Aramaic: killing (participle mpl) or killers. Unvocalized in the manuscript
וְדִי: וּ + דִּי — Aramaic: 'and (he) who'. Added in the margin
יִשְׁתַּמַּשׁ: אִשְׁתַּמַּשׁ — Aramaic/Hebrew: to make use of (Hitpael impf. 3ms); 'makes use of'
בְּתָגָא: בְּ + תָּגָא — Aramaic: crown (emphatic state); 'of the crown' — the crown of Torah, i.e. using learning for personal gain
חָלַף: חֲלַף — Aramaic: to pass away, perish (pf. 3ms); 'passes away'
אֵין: אֵין — there is not; with a pronoun, 'am not'
קְבַע: קֶבַע — fixed, permanent (m. noun/adj.); 'a fixed (thing)', i.e. make your study a fixed practice
מְקַבֵּל: קִבֵּל — to receive, welcome (Piel participle ms); 'receiving'
בְּסֵבֶר: בְּ + סֵבֶר — sever, expression, mien (m.); 'with an expression of'
יָפוֹת: יָפֶה — beautiful, pleasant (f. pl.); סֵבֶר פָּנִים יָפוֹת, 'a pleasant face' — a cheerful welcome
רַבָּן: רַבָּן — Rabban, 'our master', title of the patriarchs
וְהִיסְתַּלֵּק: וְ + הִסְתַּלֵּק — histalek, to remove oneself (Hitpael imperative ms); 'and remove yourself'
הַסָּפֵק: הַ + סָּפֵק — safek, doubt (m.); 'from doubt, from uncertainty'
לְעַשֵׂר: לְ + עִשֵּׂר — isser, to tithe (Piel inf.); 'to tithe'
עֲמָדוֹת: אֻמְדָּנוֹת / אוֹמָדוֹת — estimates (f. pl.); 'by estimate, by guesswork'. Kaufmann writes it with ayin for alef (amadot), an interchange of gutturals common in this manuscript
יָמַי: יוֹם + ־ַי — yom, day (m. pl. + 1cs suffix); 'my days'
גָּדַלְתִּי: גָּדַל — to grow up (Qal pf. 1cs); 'I grew up'
לַגּוּף: לְ + הַ + גּוּף — guf, body (m.); 'for the body', i.e. for oneself
הַעִיקָּר: הָ + עִקָּר — ikkar, the main thing, essence (m.). Kaufmann vocalizes the article with pataḥ
הַמַּרְבֶּה: הַ + מַרְבֶּה — 'whoever does much' (Hifil participle ms)
קַיָּים: קַיָּם — standing, enduring, existing (adj. ms); 'endures'. Spelled with double yod
שנ׳: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (abbr.) — 'as it is said' (Nifal pf. 3ms), written שנ׳; introduces a verse
וּמִשְׁפַּט: וּ + מִשְׁפַּט — mishpat, judgment, justice (m., construct); 'and the judgment of'
בְּשַׁעֲרֵיכֶם: בְּ + שַׁעַר + ־יכֶם — sha'ar, gate (m. pl. + 2mpl suffix); 'in your gates' (Zech 8:16)
ר׳: רַבִּי (abbr.) — Rabbi, 'my master', title of a sage, written ר׳. Standing alone, as in 2:1, 'Rabbi' is Rabbi Judah the Prince, compiler of the Mishnah
אֵי: אֵי — which, where (interrog.); אֵי זוֹ הִיא, 'which is it?'
זוֹ: זוֹ — this (demonstr. fs, Mishnaic); אֵי זוֹ, 'which (one)'
שֶׁיָּבוֹר: שֶׁ + בָּרַר — barar, to choose, select (Qal impf. 3ms, Mishnaic יָבוֹר); 'that (a person) should choose'
שֶׁהִיא: שֶׁ + הִיא — 'that is'; כָּל שֶׁהִיא, 'any (path) that is'
לְעוֹשָׂה: לְ + עוֹשָׂהּ — oseh, doer (Qal participle of asa, to do) + 3fs suffix, mappiq unwritten; 'to the one who does it' (printed לְעוֹשֶׂיהָ)
בְּמִצְוָה: בְּ + מִצְוָה — mitsva, commandment (f.); 'with a commandment'
שֶׁאֵין: שֶׁ + אֵין — 'for (there is) not'; שֶׁאֵין אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ, 'for you do not know'
מַתַּן: מַתָּן — giving, gift (m., construct); מַתַּן שְׂכָרָן, 'the granting of their reward'
שְׂכָרָן: שָׂכָר + ־ָן — sakhar, reward, wage (m.) + 3pl suffix (Mishnaic -an); 'their reward'
שֶׁלַּמִּצְוֹת: שֶׁל + הַ + מִצְוֹת — mitsvot, commandments (f. pl.); 'of the commandments' (shel joined to the noun, absorbing the article: shela-)
וְהֱוֵוי: וְ + הֱוֵי — 'and be' (Mishnaic imperative 2ms), spelled with double vav
מְחַשֵּׁב: חִשֵּׁב — ḥishev, to calculate, reckon (Piel participle ms); 'reckoning, weighing'
הֶפְסֵד: הֶפְסֵד — loss, cost (m., construct); 'the loss (incurred by)'
וּשְׂכַר: וּ + שְׂכַר — 'and the reward of' (construct of sakhar); here the gain
עֲבֵירָה: עֲבֵרָה — avera, transgression, sin (f.); spelled with yod
הִשְׂתַּכֵּל: הִסְתַּכֵּל — histakel, to look at, consider (Hitpael imperative ms); 'look closely'. Kaufmann spells it with sin
וְאֵין: וְ + אֵין — 'and not'; וְאֵין אַתָּה בָא, 'and you will not come'
לִידֵי: לִ + יְדֵי — 'into the hands of'; בָּא לִידֵי, 'come to, fall into'
לְּמַעְלָה: לְמַעְלָה — above, upward (adv.); מַה לְּמַעְלָה מִמָּךְ, 'what is above you'
מִמָּךְ: מִן + ־ךְ — 'than you, above you' (Mishnaic 2ms -akh; biblical מִמְּךָ)
עַיִן: עַיִן — eye (f.); עַיִן טוֹבָה / רָעָה, 'a good / bad eye' — generosity / envy and stinginess
וְאוֹזֶן: וְ + אֹזֶן — ozen, ear (f.), spelled with vav; 'and an ear'
מַעֲשֶׂיךָ: מַעֲשֶׂה + ־יךָ — ma'ase, deed (m. pl.) + 2ms suffix; 'your deeds'
בְּסֵפֶר: בְּ + סֵפֶר — sefer, book, scroll (m.); 'in a book'
נִכְתָּבִים: נִכְתַּב — nikhtav, to be written (Nifal participle mpl); 'are written'
רַבָּ׳: רַבָּן (abbr.) — Raban, 'our master', title of the patriarchs of Hillel's house, written רַבָּ׳
שֶׁלִּרְ׳: שֶׁל + רַבִּי (abbr.) — 'of Rabbi', written as one word with an abbreviated רְ׳
הַנָּשִׂיא: הַ + נָשִׂיא — nasi, prince, patriarch (m.); 'the Prince', title of the head of the Jewish community in the Land of Israel
יָפֶה: יָפֶה — fine, good, beautiful (adj. ms); 'it is good (to join)'
תַלְמוּד: תַּלְמוּד — talmud, study, learning (m., construct); תַּלְמוּד תּוֹרָה, 'study of Torah'
עִים: עִם — with; Kaufmann spells it with yod
דֶּרֶךְ: דֶּרֶךְ — way; דֶּרֶךְ אֶרֶץ, 'the way of the land' — here a worldly occupation, earning a living
שֶׁיְּגִיעַת: שֶׁ + יְגִיעָה — yegi'a, toil, exertion (f., construct); 'for the toil of'
מְשַׁכְּחַת: שִׁכַּח — shikaḥ, to make forget (Piel participle fs); 'makes (sin) forgotten'
תּוֹרָה: תּוֹרָה — Torah; here the study of Torah
סוֹפָה: סוֹף + ־הּ — sof, end (m.) + 3fs suffix; 'its end'. First written סוֹף; a second hand changed the final pe and added the he between the lines
בְטֵילָה: בָּטֵל — batel, idle, void, coming to nothing (adj. fs), spelled with yod; 'idle, futile'
לְגָרֵר: לְ + גָּרַר — garar, to drag, draw along (Qal inf.); 'to drag along (sin)' (printed וְגוֹרֶרֶת). The resh looks like a dalet in the manuscript
עָווֹן: עָוֹן — sin (m.), spelled with double vav
הָעֲמֵלִים: הָ + עָמֵל — amel, toiling (Qal participle mpl); 'those who toil'
הַצִּיבּוּר: הַ + צִבּוּר — tsibur, community, public (m.), spelled with yod; 'the community'
לְשֵׁם: לְ + שֵׁם — 'for the name of'; לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם, 'for the sake of Heaven'
שֶׁזְּכוּת: שֶׁ + זְכוּת — zekhut, merit (f.); 'for the merit of'
אֲבוֹתָם: אָב + ־וֹתָם — av, father, ancestor (m. pl. + 3mpl suffix); 'their fathers, their ancestors'
מְסַיַּיעַתָּם: סִיַּע + ־ָם — siya, to help, support (Piel participle fs + 3mpl suffix); 'helps them'
וְצִדְקָתָם: וְ + צְדָקָה + ־ָם — tsedaka, righteousness (f.) + 3mpl suffix; 'and their righteousness'
עוֹמֶדֶת: עָמַד — to stand (Qal participle fs); 'stands, endures'
לְעַד: לָעַד — forever (adv.); written by a second hand over an erasure
וְאַתֶּם: וְ + אַתֶּם — 'and you (pl.)'; written by a second hand over an erasure
מַעֲלִים: הֶעֱלָה — he'ela, to raise; with עַל + שָׂכָר, to credit someone with a reward (Hifil participle mpl, impersonal); 'they credit'
עֲלֵיהם: עַל + ־יהֶם — 'upon them'; the sense calls for 'upon you' (printed עֲלֵיכֶם). The he is unpointed
שָׂכָר: שָׂכָר — reward, wage (m.); the resh is a correction
כְּאִילּוּ: כְּאִלּוּ — as if, as though; spelled with yod
הֱווֹן: הֱווּ — be! (Mishnaic imperative mpl), here with a final nun: hevon
בָּרְשׁוּת: בְּ + הָ + רְשׁוּת — reshut, authority, ruling power (f.); 'with the authorities'
מְקָרְיבִין: קֵרַב — kerev, to bring near, befriend (Piel participle mpl, Mishnaic -in), spelled with yod; 'bring close'
לְצוֹרֶךְ: לְ + צֹרֶךְ — tsorekh, need (m., construct); 'for the need of'
עַצְמָן: עֶצֶם + ־ָן — 'themselves' (Mishnaic -an); לְצוֹרֶךְ עַצְמָן, 'for their own needs'
נִירְאִין: נִרְאָה — nir'a, to appear, seem (Nifal participle mpl, -in), spelled with yod; 'they seem'
בְּאֹהֲבִין: בְּ + אוֹהֵב — ohev, friend, lover (m. pl., -in); 'as friends' (printed כְּאוֹהֲבִין)
בְּשַׁעַת: בִּ + שָׁעָה — sha'a, hour, time (f., construct); 'at the time of'
הֲנָיָתָן: הֲנָאָה + ־ָן — hana'a, benefit, profit (f.) + 3mpl suffix; 'their benefit'. Kaufmann spells hanaya, with yod
דּוֹחֲקוֹ: דֹּחַק + ־וֹ — doḥak, distress, hardship (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'his distress'
רְצוֹנוֹ: רָצוֹן + ־וֹ — ratson, will, wish (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'His will' (God's)
שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה: שֶׁ + עָשָׂה — 'so that He will do' (Qal impf. 3ms)
רְצוֹנָך: רָצוֹן + ־ָךְ — 'your will' (the final kaf without its shva)
בַּטֵּל: בִּטֵּל — bitel, to set aside, cancel (Piel imperative ms); 'set aside'
מִפְּנֵי: מִפְּנֵי — before, because of; here 'in favor of, for the sake of'
שֶׁיְּבַטֵּל: שֶׁ + בִּטֵּל — 'so that He will set aside' (Piel impf. 3ms)
א׳: אוֹמֵר (abbr.)? — written א׳ in ר׳ א׳ before Hillel's name, most naturally 'Rabbi says', a phrase out of place here (printed: הִלֵּל אוֹמֵר). Uncertain
תִּיפְרוֹשׁ: פָּרַשׁ — parash, to separate oneself, withdraw (Qal impf./jussive 2ms), spelled with yod; with אַל, 'do not separate'
תַּאֲמִין: הֶאֱמִין — he'emin, to believe, trust (Hifil impf./jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not trust'
תָּדִין: דָּן — dan, to judge (Qal impf./jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not judge'
שֶׁתַּגִּיַע: שֶׁ + הִגִּיעַ — higi'a, to reach, arrive (Hifil impf. 2ms); עַד שֶׁתַּגִּיעַ, 'until you reach'
לִמְקוֹמוֹ: לִ + מָקוֹם + ־וֹ — makom, place (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'his place', i.e. his situation
שֶׁאי: שֶׁ + אִי — 'that not'; אִי אֶפְשָׁר, 'it is impossible'. אי added unvocalized by a second hand; the scribe first wrote שֶׁאֶפְשָׁר, 'that can'
לְהִישָּׁמַע: לְהִשָּׁמַע — to be heard, understood (Nifal inf. of shama), spelled with yod; 'to be heard'
תֹּאמַ׳: תֹּאמַר (abbr.) — 'say' (Qal impf./jussive 2ms), written תֹּאמַ׳; with אַל, 'do not say'
כְּשֶׁאֶפָּנֶה: כְּשֶׁ + נִפְנָה — nifna, to be free, have leisure (Nifal impf. 1cs); 'when I have time'
אֶשְׁנֶה: שָׁנָה — shana, to repeat, study (oral teaching) (Qal impf. 1cs); 'I will study'. The root of the word Mishnah
תִיפָּנֶה: נִפְנָה — 'you will have time' (Nifal impf. 2ms), spelled with yod
בּוּר: בּוּר — bur, boor, uncultivated man (m.); from a word for fallow land. Compare בּוֹר, 'cistern', in 2:8
חֵט: חֵטְא — ḥet, sin (m.); Kaufmann writes it without the alef
עַם: עַם — people (m.); עַם הָאָרֶץ, see the next word
הָאָרֶץ: הָ + אֶרֶץ — 'the land'; עַם הָאָרֶץ, 'people of the land' — an unlearned man, careless of the rabbinic rules
הַבּוֹיְשָׁן: הַ + בַּיְשָׁן — bayshan, bashful, shy person (m.); Kaufmann vocalizes boyshan
הַקּוֹפְדָן: הַ + קַפְּדָן — kapdan, short-tempered, exacting person (m.); Kaufmann vocalizes kofdan
מְלַמֵּד: לִמֵּד — limed, to teach (Piel participle ms); 'teaches'
בִסְחוֹרָה: בִּ + סְחוֹרָה — seḥora, trade, commerce (f.); 'in trade'. The בִ was added by a second hand
מַחְכִּים: הֶחְכִּים — heḥkim, to grow wise (Hifil participle ms); 'grows wise'
וּבִמְקוֹם: וּ + בִּ + מָקוֹם — 'and in a place (where)'. The וּ was added by a second hand
הִשְׁתַּדֵּל: הִשְׁתַּדֵּל — hishtadel, to strive, make an effort (Hitpael imperative ms); 'strive'
אָחַד: אַחַת — one (f.); 'a (skull)'. Kaufmann writes the masculine spelling, vocalized aḥad
צָפָה: צָף — tsaf, to float (Qal participle fs); 'floating'
פְּנֵי: פָּנִים — face (construct pl.); עַל פְּנֵי, 'on the surface of'
וְאָמַ׳: וְ + אָמַר (abbr.) — 'and said', written וְאָמַ׳; the vav was added by a second hand
לֹהּ: לָהּ — 'to it, to her' (f.). The transcription records a dot over the lamed; read lah
דְּאַטִיפְתְּ: Aramaic: דְּ + אַטֵיף — 'that' + atif, to make float, drown (Afel pf. 2fs); עַל דְּאַטִיפְתְּ, 'because you drowned (others)'
אֲטִיפוּךְ: Aramaic: אַטֵיף + ־ךְ — 'they drowned you (f.)' (Afel pf. 3mpl + 2fs suffix)
מַטִּיפַייִךְ: Aramaic: מַטֵיף + ־ַיִךְ — 'those who drowned you (f.)' (Afel participle mpl + 2fs suffix)
יְטוּפוּן: Aramaic: טוּף — tuf, to float (Peal impf. 3mpl, ending -un); 'they will float', i.e. be drowned
מַרְבֶּה: הִרְבָּה — 'one who increases' (Hifil participle ms); מַרְבֶּה X מַרְבֶּה Y, 'the more X, the more Y'
רִימָּה: רִמָּה — rima, worms, maggots (f. coll.), spelled with yod
דָיוֹן: uncertain — דָיוֹן, written over an erasure, a form not otherwise known. The printed text has דְּאָגָה, 'worry', which fits the context
זִימָּה: זִמָּה — zima, lewdness, sexual license (f.), spelled with yod
קָנָה: קָנָה — kana, to acquire (Qal pf. 3ms); 'acquired'; here 'whoever has acquired'
הַבָּא: הַ + בָּא — 'the coming'; הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, 'the world to come'
זַכַּיִי: זַכַּאי — Zakkai (proper name); Kaufmann spells it with double yod
וּמִשַּׁמַּיִ: וּ + מִ + שַׁמַּאי — 'and from Shammai'; Kaufmann ends the name with a yod pointed ḥiriq (Shamay). The וּ was added by a second hand
עָשִׂיתָ: עָשָׂה — to do (Qal pf. 2ms); 'you have done' (printed לָמַדְתָּ, 'learned')
תַּחֲזִיק: הֶחֱזִיק — heḥezik, to hold (Hifil impf./jussive 2ms); אַל תַּחֲזִיק טוֹבָה לְעַצְמָךְ, 'take no credit'
טוֹבָה: טוֹבָה — good, favor (f.); also the adjective 'good' (fs), as in דֶּרֶךְ טוֹבָה
נוֹצַרְתָּ: נוֹצַר — notsar, to be created (Nifal pf. 2ms); 'you were created'
הָיוּ: הָיָה — to be (Qal pf. 3pl); הָיוּ לוֹ, 'he had'
לְרַ׳ָ: לְ + רַבָּן (abbr.) — 'to Rabban', written לְרַ׳ with a qamats on the abbreviation; הָיוּ לוֹ לְרַבָּן יוֹחָנָן, 'Rabban Yoḥanan had'
וְאֵילּוּ: וְ + אֵלּוּ — 'and these', spelled with yod
הֵן: הֵן — they (pron. 3pl); וְאֵלּוּ הֵן, 'and these are they'
אֱלִיעֶזֶר: אֱלִיעֶזֶר — Eliezer (proper name); Rabbi Eliezer ben Hyrcanus
יוֹסֵף: יוֹסֵף — Yosef (proper name); the printed editions call this disciple Yose (יוֹסֵי)
הַכֹּהֵן: הַ + כֹּהֵן — kohen, priest (m.); 'the Priest'. Added in the margin by a second hand
עָרָךְ: עֲרָךְ — Arakh (proper name); Elazar ben Arakh
מוֹנֶה: מָנָה — mana, to count, list (Qal participle ms); 'listing'. The נֶ is a correction
בּוֹר: בּוֹר — bor, cistern, pit (m.). Compare בּוּר, 'boor', in 2:5
סוּד: סוּד — plastered, lined with lime (Qal passive participle of sud, to plaster); בּוֹר סוּד, 'a plastered cistern', which holds every drop
שֶׁאֵינוּ: שֶׁ + אֵינוֹ — 'that does not'; Kaufmann vocalizes einu
מְאַבֵּד: אִבֵּד — ibed, to lose (Piel participle ms); 'loses'
יוֹלַדְתּוֹ: יוֹלֶדֶת + ־וֹ — yoledet, she who bore (Qal participle fs) + 3ms suffix; 'she who bore him, his mother'
מִתְגַּבֵּר: הִתְגַּבֵּר — hitgaber, to grow stronger, surge (Hitpael participle ms); 'growing stronger'
יִהְיוּ: הָיָה — 'were' (Qal impf. 3mpl, in a condition); אִם יִהְיוּ, 'if (all) were'
בְּכַף: בְּ + כַּף — 'in the pan (of a scale)'
מֹאזְנַיִם: מֹאזְנַיִם — scales, balance (dual); כַּף מֹאזְנַיִם, 'a pan of the scales'
שְׁנִייָּה: שֵׁנִי — second, other (adj. fs), spelled with double yod; 'the other'
מַכְרִיַע: הִכְרִיעַ — hikhri'a, to tip the scale, outweigh (Hifil participle ms); 'outweighs'
כּוּלָּם: כֹּל + ־ָם — 'all of them', spelled with vav
אַבָּא: אַבָּא — Abba, 'father' (Aramaic), an honorific before a sage's name
מִשְּׁמוֹ: מִ + שֵׁם + ־וֹ — 'in his name' (lit. 'from his name'), quoting him
עַרָךְ: עֲרָךְ — Arakh (proper name), here vocalized with pataḥ
אָמַ׳: אָמַר (abbr.) — amar, said (Qal pf. 3ms), written אָמַ׳
צְאוּ: יָצָא — to go out (Qal imperative mpl); 'go out'
דֶרֶך: דֶּרֶךְ — path (the final kaf without its shva)
שֶׁיִּדְבַּק: שֶׁ + דָּבַק — davak, to cling, hold fast (Qal impf. 3ms); 'that (a person) should cling (to)'
רֶ׳: רַבִּי (abbr.) — Rabbi, here pointed with segol (re-), perhaps for a pronunciation like Rebbi
הָרוֹאֶה: הָ + רָאָה — 'the one who sees' (Qal participle ms)
הַנּוֹלָד: הַ + נוֹלָד — nolad, being born (Nifal participle ms); 'what is coming into being', i.e. the consequences
לְעָזָר: לְעָזָר — Le'azar, short form of Elazar (proper name), common in Palestinian sources
רוֹאֶה: רָאָה — to see (Qal participle ms); רוֹאֶה אֲנִי … מִ…, 'I prefer … to …'
דִּבְרֵי: דִּבְרֵי — 'the words of' (construct pl. of davar)
מִדִּבְרֵיכֶם: מִ + דָּבָר + ־יכֶם — 'over your words, rather than your words'
שֶׁבִּכְלַל: שֶׁ + בִּ + כְלָל — kelal, sum, whole (m.); 'for within'
שֶׁיִּתְרָחַק: שֶׁ + הִתְרַחֵק — hitraḥek, to keep away (Hitpael impf. 3ms); 'that (a person) should keep away'
הַלֹּוֶוה: הַ + לֹוֶה — love, borrower (Qal participle ms of lava, to borrow), spelled with double vav; 'the one who borrows'
וְאֵינוּ: וְ + אֵינוֹ — 'and does not'; Kaufmann vocalizes einu. The yod was added by a second hand
מְשַׁלֵּם: שִׁלֵּם — shilem, to pay, repay (Piel participle ms); 'repays'
אֶחָד: אֶחָד — one (m.); אֶחָד … כְּ…, 'X is the same as Y'
לֹווֶה: לֹוֶה — 'one who borrows' (Qal participle ms), spelled with double vav
הַמָּקוֹם: הַ + מָקוֹם — 'the Place'; a rabbinic name for God: 'the Omnipresent'
וְצַדִּיק: וְ + צַדִּיק — 'and the righteous (one)'. The vav is bracketed in the transcription
חוֹנֵן: חָנַן — ḥanan, to be gracious, show favor (Qal participle ms)
כְבוֹד: כָּבוֹד — honor, dignity (m., construct); 'the honor of'
עָלֶיךָ: עַל + ־ֶיךָ — 'upon you'; חָבִיב עָלֶיךָ, 'dear to you'
כְנַפְשָׁךְ: כְּ + נֶפֶשׁ + ־ָךְ — nefesh, soul, self (f.); 'as your own self'. A marginal note gives the variant כְשֶׁלָּךְ, 'as your own'
נוֹחַ: נוֹחַ — easy (adj. ms); נוֹחַ לִכְעוֹס, 'easily angered'
לִכְעוֹס: כָּעַס — ka'as, to be angry (Qal inf.); 'to anger'
וְשׁוּב: וְ + שׁוּב — shuv, to return, repent (Qal imperative ms); 'and repent'
מִתְחַמֵּם: הִתְחַמֵּם — hitḥamem, to warm oneself (Hitpael participle ms); 'warming yourself'
שֶׁלַּחֲכָמִ׳: שֶׁל + הַ + חֲכָמִים (abbr.) — 'of the sages', written שֶׁלַּחֲכָמִ׳
מִגַּחַלְתָּן: מִ + גַּחֶלֶת + ־ָן — gaḥelet, glowing coal (f.) + 3mpl suffix; 'of their coal'
תִּכָּוֶוה: נִכְוָה — nikhva, to be burned, scorched (Nifal impf. 2ms), spelled with double vav; 'you be burned'
שֶׁנְּשִׁיכָתָן: שֶׁ + נְשִׁיכָה + ־ָן — neshikha, bite (f.) + 3mpl suffix; 'for their bite'
וַעֲקִיצָתָן: וַ + עֲקִיצָה + ־ָן — akitsa, sting (f.) + 3mpl suffix; 'and their sting'
וּלְחִישָׁתָן: וּ + לְחִישָׁה + ־ָן — leḥisha, hiss, whisper; also a whispered charm (f.) + 3mpl suffix; 'and their hiss'
שָׂרָף: שָׂרָף — saraf, a venomous 'burning' serpent (m.); cf. Numbers 21:6
וְיֶצֶר: וְ + יֵצֶר — yetser, inclination, impulse (m.); 'and the inclination (of)'
הָרַע: הָ + רַע — 'the evil'; יֵצֶר הָרַע, 'the evil inclination'
וְשִׂנְאַת: וְ + שִׂנְאָה — sin'a, hatred (f., construct); 'and hatred of'
מוֹצִיאִין: הוֹצִיא — hotsi, to bring out, remove (Hifil participle mpl, -in); 'drive out'
מְמוֹן: מָמוֹן — mamon, money, property (m.); Kaufmann vocalizes memon
עָלֵיךָ: עַל + ־ֵיךָ — 'upon you'; Kaufmann vocalizes with tsere
הַתְקֵן: הִתְקִין — hitkin, to prepare, make ready (Hifil imperative ms); 'prepare'
לִלְמֹד: לָמַד — to learn, study (Qal inf.); 'to study'
יִהִיוּ: הָיָה — 'let (them) be' (Qal jussive 3mpl); Kaufmann vocalizes yihiyu
הֱוֵוי: הֱוֵי — be! (Mishnaic imperative 2ms), spelled with double vav
בְּקִירְיַית: בִּ + קְרִיאָה — keri'a, reading, recitation (f., construct); 'with the recitation of'. Kaufmann: kiryat, without the alef
שְׁמַע: שְׁמַע — Shema, 'Hear!' (Deuteronomy 6:4), the name of the recitation; קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע, 'the recitation of the Shema'
מִתְפַּלֵּל: הִתְפַּלֵּל — hitpalel, to pray (Hitpael participle ms); 'praying'
בָּ״הֻ: בָּרוּךְ הוּא (abbr.) — barukh hu, 'blessed be He'
אֶרֶךְ: אֶרֶךְ — long (construct); אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם, 'long of anger', slow to anger
תְּהִי: הָיָה — 'be' (Qal jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not be'
בִּפְנֵי: בִּ + פְּנֵי — 'before, in the face of'; בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָךְ, 'in your own eyes'
שָׁקֵד: שָׁקֵד — diligent, assiduous (adj. ms; printed שָׁקוּד)
שֶׁתָּשִׁיב: שֶׁ + הֵשִׁיב — heshiv, to reply (Hifil impf. 2ms); מַה שֶּׁתָּשִׁיב, 'what you should answer'
לַאֲפִיקוֹרוֹס: לְ + אֲפִיקוֹרוֹס — apikoros, Epicurean (from Greek); in rabbinic use a scoffer at the tradition, an unbeliever
בַעַל: בַּעַל — master, owner (construct); בַּעַל מְלַאכְתָּךְ, 'your employer'
טַרְפוֹן: טַרְפוֹן — Tarfon (proper name, from Greek Tryphon)
מְרוּבָּה: מְרֻבָּה — much, great (Pual participle fs), spelled with vav; 'is great'
וְהַפּוֹעֲלִים: וְ + הַ + פּוֹעֵל — po'el, laborer, hired worker (m. pl.); 'and the laborers'
הַבַּיִת: הַ + בַּיִת — 'the house'; בַּעַל הַבַּיִת, 'the householder, the employer'
דּוֹחֵק: דָּחַק — daḥak, to press, urge (Qal participle ms); 'is pressing'
לִגְמוֹר: גָּמַר — gamar, to finish (Qal inf.); 'to finish'
חוֹרִים: חוֹרִין — free men (m. pl.); בֶּן חוֹרִין, 'a free man'. Kaufmann: ḥorim, with -im
לִיבָּטֵל: לְהִבָּטֵל — to be idle, desist (Nifal inf., Mishnaic form without the he), spelled with yod; 'to desist'
לָמַדְתָּה: לָמַד — to learn (Qal pf. 2ms), spelled with a final he; 'you have learned'
מֵאַיִין: מֵ + אַיִן — ayin, where? (with me-, 'from'); 'from where'. Spelled with double yod
בָּאתָה: בָּא — ba, to come (Qal pf. 2ms); 'you came'. Kaufmann writes the ending with a final he (בָּאתָה for בָּאתָ)
וּלְאַיין: וּ + לְ + אַיִן — 'and to where, and where to'. Spelled with double yod; the yods carry no points
הוֹלֵךְ: הָלַךְ — halakh, to go (Qal participle ms); 'going'
עָתִיד: עָתִיד — atid, destined, about to (adj. ms); with an infinitive, 'are to, will one day'
לִיתֵּן: לִתֵּן — liten, to give (Qal inf. of natan, Mishnaic form); 'to give'. Spelled with yod
דִּין: דִּין — din, judgment (m.); דִּין וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן, 'judgment and account', a full reckoning
וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן: וְ + חֶשְׁבּוֹן — ḥeshbon, account, reckoning (m.); 'and account'
מֵנַיִן: מִנַּיִן — 'from where?' (contracted from מִן + אַיִן); here 'where (you came) from'. Kaufmann points it menayin
מִלֵּחָה: מִ + לֵחָה — leḥa, moisture, fluid (f.); 'from a fluid' — the seminal fluid. Printed editions: מִטִּפָּה, 'from a drop'
סְרוּחָה: סָרוּחַ — saruaḥ, putrid, stinking (passive participle fs); 'putrid'
לְרִימָּה: לְ + רִמָּה — rima, worm, maggot (f.); 'to the worm'. Spelled with yod
וּלְתוֹלֵיעָה: וּ + לְ + תּוֹלֵעָה — tole'a, worm (f.); 'and to the maggot'. Spelled with yod
לִיתֵן: לִתֵּן — 'to give' (as לִיתֵּן above, here written without the dagesh)
מַלְכֵי: מֶלֶךְ — kings of (construct pl.); מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, 'the King of the kings of kings' — God, above the Persian 'king of kings'
הַקָבָּ״הֻ: הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא (abbr.) — ha-Kadosh barukh hu, 'the Holy One, blessed be He', a rabbinic name for God; written הקב״ה
סְגַן: סְגָן — segan, deputy (m. construct); סְגַן הַכֹּהֲנִים, 'deputy of the priests', the officer next in rank to the high priest
הַכֹּהֲנִים: הַ + כֹּהֵן — kohen, priest (m. pl.); 'the priests'
בִּשְׁלֹמָהּ: בְּ + שָׁלוֹם + ־הּ — shalom, peace, welfare (+ 3fs suffix); 'for its welfare'
שֶׁלַּמַּלְכוּת: שֶׁל + הַ + מַּלְכוּת — malkhut, kingdom, government (f.); 'of the kingdom', i.e. the government. Written as one word, the he of the article absorbed
שֶׁאִילּוּלֵי: שֶׁ + אִלּוּלֵי — ilulei, were it not for; 'for were it not for'
מוֹרָאָה: מוֹרָא + ־הּ — mora, fear, awe (m. + 3fs suffix); 'fear of it' (of the government). The final he has no mappiq
רְעֵהוּ: רֵעַ + ־הוּ — re'a, fellow, neighbour (+ 3ms suffix); אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ, 'one another'
בָּלַעְנוּ: בָּלַע — bala, to swallow (Qal pf. 1cpl); 'we would have swallowed'. Printed editions: בְּלָעוֹ, 'would swallow him'
תַּרְדְּיוֹן: תַּרְדְּיוֹן — Teradyon (proper name); Ḥananya ben Teradyon
יוֹשְׁבִים: יָשַׁב — yashav, to sit (Qal participle mpl); 'sitting'
הֲרֵי: הֲרֵי — harei, behold; הֲרֵי זֶה, 'this is, this counts as'
מוֹשַׁב: מוֹשָׁב — moshav, seat, session (m. construct); 'a seat of'
וּבְמוֹשַׁב: וּ + בְּ + מוֹשָׁב — 'and in the seat of' (Psalm 1:1)
וַעֲסוּקִים: וַ + עָסוּק — asuk, occupied, engaged (passive participle mpl); 'and occupied (with)'
בְּדִבְרֵי: בְּ + דִּבְרֵי — divrei, words of (construct pl. of davar); 'with words of'
שְׁכִינָה: שְׁכִינָה — shekhina, literally 'dwelling' (f.); the divine Presence
נִדְבְּרוּ: נִדְבַּר — nidbar, to speak together (Nifal pf. 3mpl); 'spoke with one another'
יִרְאֵי: יָרֵא — yare, fearing (adj., construct pl.); 'those who fear'
יָ׳י: יהוה (abbr.) — the divine name, written יָ׳י; read Adonay, 'the LORD'
וַיַּקְשֵׁב: וַ + הִקְשִׁיב — hikshiv, to listen, attend (Hifil impf. 3ms with vav-consecutive); 'and he listened'
וַיּשְׁמַע: וַ + שָׁמַע — shama, to hear (Qal impf. 3ms with vav-consecutive); 'and he heard'. The yod has no vowel point
וַיִּכָּתֵב: וַ + נִכְתַּב — nikhtav, to be written (Nifal impf. 3ms with vav-consecutive); 'and was written'
זִכָּרוֹן: זִכָּרוֹן — zikaron, remembrance, memorial (m.); סֵפֶר זִכָּרוֹן, 'a book of remembrance'
יָ״י: יהוה (abbr.) — the divine name, here written יָ״י; read Adonay, 'the LORD'
וּלְחֹשְׁבֵי: וּ + לְ + חוֹשֵׁב — ḥoshev, thinking, esteeming (Qal participle construct pl. of ḥashav); 'and for those who think on'
שֶׁאָכְלוּ: שֶׁ + אָכַל — akhal, to eat (Qal pf. 3mpl); 'who ate'
שׁוּלְחָן: שֻׁלְחָן — shulḥan, table (m.); Kaufmann spells it with vav
אֵילּוּ: אֵלּוּ — elu, these (Mishnaic); spelled with yod
כְאֹכְלֵי: כְּ + אוֹכֵל — okhel, eating (Qal participle construct pl.); 'like eaters of'
זִבְחֵי: זֶבַח — zevaḥ, sacrifice (m. construct pl.); 'sacrifices of'
מֵתִים: מֵת — met, dead (m. pl.); זִבְחֵי מֵתִים, 'sacrifices of the dead' (Psalm 106:28) — offerings to idols
שׁוּלְחָנוֹת: שֻׁלְחָן — 'tables' (m. pl. in -ot); spelled with vav
מַלְאוּ: מָלֵא — male, to be full (Qal pf. 3pl); 'are full'. Kaufmann points the first syllable with pataḥ
מָקוֹם: מָקוֹם — makom, place (m.); בְּלִי מָקוֹם, 'with no place (left clean)' — heard here also as 'without the Omnipresent'
אֲבַל: אֲבָל — aval, but. Kaufmann points the second syllable with pataḥ
על: עַל — al, on, at. Unvocalized in the manuscript
אָכְלוּ: אָכַל — akhal, to eat (Qal pf. 3mpl); 'they ate'
מִשֻּׁלְחָנוּ: מִ + שֻׁלְחָן + ־וֹ — 'from his table'. Kaufmann points the suffix with shuruk (-u)
שֶׁלְהַקָּבָּ״הֻ: שֶׁל + הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא (abbr.) — 'of the Holy One, blessed be He'
וַיְּדַבֵּר: וַ + דִּבֵּר — diber, to speak (Piel impf. 3ms with vav-consecutive); 'and he spoke'
אֵלַיִ: אֵלַי — 'to me'. Kaufmann's final yod carries a ḥiriq: read elay
חֲכִינַיִ: חֲכִינַאי — Ḥakhinay (proper name); Kaufmann's final yod carries a ḥiriq
הַנֵּיעוֹר: הַ + נֵעוֹר — ne'or, waking, staying awake (Nifal participle ms of ur); 'one who stays awake'. Spelled with yod
וְהַמְהַלֵּךְ: וְ + הַ + מְהַלֵּךְ — mehalekh, walking (Piel participle ms of halakh); 'and one who walks'
בַּדֶּרֶךְ: בַּ + דֶּרֶךְ — derekh, road, way (f.); 'on the road'
וּמַפְנֶה: וּ + הִפְנָה — hifna, to turn, clear (Hifil participle ms); 'and turns'
לִבּוֹ: לֵב + ־וֹ — lev, heart (m.); 'his heart', i.e. his mind
לְבַטָּלָה: לְ + בַּטָּלָה — batala, idleness, emptiness (f.); 'to idleness, to idle things'
מִתְחַיֵּיב: הִתְחַיֵּב — hitḥayev, to become liable (Hitpael participle ms); מִתְחַיֵּב בְּנַפְשׁוֹ, 'forfeits his life'. Spelled with double yod
בְּנַפְשׁוֹ: בְּ + נֶפֶשׁ + ־וֹ — nefesh, soul, life (f.); 'with his life'
הַקָּנָה: הַקָּנָה — Ha-Kana (proper name); Neḥunya ben Ha-Kana
הַמְקַבֵּל: הַ + מְקַבֵּל — 'whoever receives, takes on' (Piel participle ms of kibel)
עוֹל: עוֹל — ol, yoke (m.); a burden one carries
מַעֲבִירִים: הֶעֱבִיר — he'evir, to remove, take away (Hifil participle mpl); 'they remove'
מַלְכוּת: מַלְכוּת — malkhut, kingdom, government (f.); עוֹל מַלְכוּת, 'the yoke of government' — taxes and forced labour
הַפּוֹרֵק: הַ + פָּרַק — parak, to throw off, unload (Qal participle ms); 'whoever throws off'
נוֹתְנִים: נָתַן — natan, to give, put (Qal participle mpl); 'they put'
חֶלְפְּתָה: חֲלַפְתָּא — Ḥalafta (proper name); Kaufmann points it Ḥelpeta
כְּפַר: כְּפַר — kfar, village (m. construct); כְּפַר חֲנַנְיָה, Kefar Ḥananya, a village in Galilee
נִצָּב: נִצָּב — nitsav, standing, stationed (Nifal participle ms); 'stands'
בַּעֲדַת: בַּ + עֵדָה — eda, congregation (f. construct); 'in the congregation of'. In rabbinic reckoning an עֵדָה is ten
מְנַיִן: מִנַּיִן — minayin, from where? — the formula that asks for a verse as proof; 'how do we know?'
אֲפִילוּ: אֲפִלּוּ — afilu, even (spelled here without the dagesh)
בְּקֶרֶב: בְּ + קֶרֶב — kerev, midst (m.); 'in the midst of'
אֱלֹהִים: אֱלֹהִים — Elohim, God; in Psalm 82:1 read here as 'judges'
יִשְׁפֹּט: שָׁפַט — shafat, to judge (Qal impf. 3ms); 'he judges'
וַאֲגוּדָּתוֹ: וַ + אֲגֻדָּה + ־וֹ — aguda, bundle, band (f. + 3ms suffix); 'and his bundle' (Amos 9:6). Spelled with vav
יְסָדָהּ: יָסַד + ־הּ — yasad, to found (Qal pf. 3ms + 3fs suffix); 'he founded it'
וּלְחוֹשְׁבֵי: וּ + לְ + חוֹשֵׁב — 'and for those who think on' (spelled with vav)
אַזְכִּיר: הִזְכִּיר — hizkir, to mention, cause to be remembered (Hifil impf. 1cs); 'I cause (my name) to be remembered'
אָבוֹא: בָּא — ba, to come (Qal impf. 1cs); 'I will come'
וּבֵרַכְתִּיךָ: וּ + בֵּרַךְ + ־ךָ — berakh, to bless (Piel pf. 1cs with vav-consecutive + 2ms suffix); 'and I will bless you'
בִּרְתוֹתָה: בִּרְתוֹתָא — Bartota, a place name; Kaufmann points it Birtota
תֶּן: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal imperative ms); 'give'
שֶׁאַתְּ: שֶׁ + אַתְּ — 'for you'; Mishnaic אַתְּ, 'you', serves for a man as well
וְשֶׁלָּךְ: וְ + שֶׁל + ־ָךְ — 'and what is yours' (Mishnaic 2ms suffix)
וְכֵן: וְ + כֵן — ken, so, thus; 'and so'. כֵן written by a second hand over an erasure
בְּדָוִד: בְּ + דָּוִד — David (proper name); 'about David, by David'
מִיָּדְךָ: מִ + יָד + ־ךָ — yad, hand (f.); 'from your hand'. The verse (1 Chronicles 29:14) reads וּמִיָּדְךָ; here its vav was erased
נָתַנּוּ: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal pf. 1cpl); 'we have given'
הַמְהַלֵּךְ: הַ + מְהַלֵּךְ — 'one who walks' (Piel participle ms)
וְשׁוֹנֶה: וְ + שָׁנָה — shana, to repeat, recite one's learning (Qal participle ms); 'and is reciting'
וּמַפְסִיק: וּ + הִפְסִיק — hifsik, to interrupt, break off (Hifil participle ms); 'and breaks off'
מִשְׁנָתוֹ: מִשְׁנָה + ־וֹ — mishna, what one has learned by repetition (f.); 'his learning, his recitation'
וְאוֹ׳: וְ + אוֹמֵר (abbr.) — ve-omer, 'and says', written וְאוֹ׳
נָּאֶה: נָאֶה — na'e, lovely, fine (adj. ms); מַה נָּאֶה, 'how lovely'
אִילָן: אִילָן — ilan, tree (m.); the Mishnaic word for biblical עֵץ
מַעֲלִין: הֶעֱלָה — he'ela, to raise; here to reckon (Hifil participle mpl); מַעֲלִין עָלָיו, 'they reckon it to him, he is regarded'
מִתְחַיֵּב: הִתְחַיֵּב — hitḥayev, to become liable (Hitpael participle ms); 'is liable'
דוֹסְתִּי: דּוֹסְתַּאי — Dostai (proper name); Kaufmann points it Dosti
בִרְ׳: בְּרַבִּי (abbr.) — birabi, 'son of Rabbi', written בִרְ׳
יַנַּיִי: יַנַּאי — Yannai (proper name); spelled with double yod
הַשָׁכַח: הַ + שָׁכַח — shakhaḥ, to forget (Qal pf. 3ms, with the article as relative); 'who has forgotten'. Printed editions: הַשּׁוֹכֵחַ
מִמִּשְׁנָתוֹ: מִ + מִשְׁנָה + ־וֹ — 'from his learning'. The second mem is a second hand's writing over an erasure
מַעְלִין: הֶעֱלָה — he'ela, to reckon (Hifil participle mpl); 'they reckon'. Kaufmann points it ma'lin
הִשָּׁמֵר: נִשְׁמַר — nishmar, to take care, beware (Nifal imperative ms); 'take care'
וּשְׁמֹר: וּ + שָׁמַר — shamar, to guard, keep (Qal imperative ms); 'and guard'
תִּשְׁכַּח: שָׁכַח — shakhaḥ, to forget (Qal impf. 2ms); 'you forget'
עֵינֶיךָ: עַיִן + ־ֶיךָ — ayin, eye (f. du. + 2ms suffix); 'your eyes'
יָכוֹל: יָכוֹל — yakhol, able; in midrash, 'one might think' — the formula that proposes a reading in order to rule it out
תַקְפָה: תָּקַף — takaf, to overpower, be too strong for (Qal pf. 3fs); 'overpowered'
תַּלְמוּד: תַּלְמוּד — talmud, teaching (m.); תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר, 'the teaching says', i.e. 'therefore the verse says'
לוֹמַ׳: לוֹמַר (abbr.) — lomar, to say (Qal inf. of amar), written לוֹמַ׳
יָסוּרוּ: סָר — sar, to turn aside, depart (Qal impf. 3mpl); 'they turn away'
מִלְבָבְךָ: מִ + לֵבָב + ־ךָ — levav, heart (m.); 'from your heart'
יְמֵי: יוֹם — yom, day (m. construct pl.); 'days of'
אֵינוּ: אֵינוֹ — eino, he is not (אֵין + 3ms suffix); Kaufmann spells it with shuruk, einu
שֶׁיֵּשֶׁב: שֶׁ + יָשַׁב — 'that he sits' (Qal impf. 3ms); עַד שֶׁיֵּשֵׁב, 'until he sits'
וִיסִירֵם: וִ + הֵסִיר + ־ֵם — hesir, to remove (Hifil impf. 3ms + 3mpl suffix); 'and removes them'
חֲנִינָה: חֲנִינָא — Ḥanina (proper name); Kaufmann spells it with final he
דּוֹסָה: דּוֹסָא — Dosa (proper name); Kaufmann spells it with final he
שֶׁיִּרְאַת: שֶׁ + יִרְאָה — yir'a, fear (f. construct); 'whose fear of'
חֶטְאוֹ: חֵטְא + ־וֹ — ḥet, sin (m.); 'his sin'. יִרְאַת חֵטְא, 'fear of sin', is the dread of doing wrong
קוֹדֶמֶת: קָדַם — kadam, to precede (Qal participle fs); 'comes before'
לְחָכְמָתוֹ: לְ + חָכְמָה + ־וֹ — 'to his wisdom', i.e. 'before his wisdom'. An erased vav stood after the lamed
חָכְמָתוֹ: חָכְמָה + ־וֹ — ḥokhma, wisdom (f.); 'his wisdom'. A vav after the ḥet was erased
מִתְקַיֶּימֶת: הִתְקַיֵּם — hitkayem, to endure, last (Hitpael participle fs); 'endures'. Spelled with double yod
לְיִרְאַת: לְ + יִרְאָה — 'to the fear of', i.e. 'before the fear of'
חָוכְמָתוֹ: חָכְמָה + ־וֹ — 'his wisdom', spelled with vav for the short o (חוכמה); the later hand that erased most of these vavs left this one
שֶׁמַּעֲשָׂיו: שֶׁ + מַעֲשִׂים + ־יו — ma'ase, deed (m. pl. + 3ms suffix); 'whose deeds'
מְרוּבִּים: מְרֻבֶּה — merube, many, abundant (Pual participle mpl); 'are more (than)'
שֶׁרוּחַ: שֶׁ + רוּחַ — 'whose spirit, with whom the spirit (of)'
הַבְּרִיוֹת: הַ + בְּרִיּוֹת — beriyot, creatures, people (f. pl.); 'people'. Spelled with one yod
נוֹחָה: נוֹחַ — noaḥ, at ease, pleased (adj. fs); רוּחַ … נוֹחָה מִמֶּנּוּ, 'is pleased with him'
הֵימֶנּוּ: מִמֶּנּוּ — 'from him'; הֵימֶנּוּ is a Mishnaic by-form
דוֹסָה: דּוֹסָא — Dosa (proper name), spelled with final he
הַרְכִינָס: הַרְכִּינָס — Harkinas (proper name, from Greek Hyrkanos)
שַׁחְרִית: שַׁחֲרִית — shaḥarit, morning; שְׁנַת שַׁחְרִית, 'late-morning sleep'
וְיֵין: וְ + יַיִן — yayin, wine (m. construct); 'and wine of'
וְשִׂיחַת: וְ + שִׂיחָה — siḥa, talk, chatter (f. construct); 'and chatter of'
הַיְלָדִים: הַ + יְלָדִים — yeled, child (m. pl.); 'the children'
וִישִׁיבַת: וִ + יְשִׁיבָה — yeshiva, sitting (f. construct); 'and sitting in'
כְּנֵסָיוֹת: כְּנֵסִיָּה — knesiya, gathering, meeting house (f. pl.); 'assemblies'. Printed editions: בָּתֵּי כְנֵסִיּוֹת
שֶׁלְעַמֵּי: שֶׁל + עַמֵּי — amei, peoples of (construct pl. of am); עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ, 'the people of the land' — the unlearned
הַמּוּדָעִי: הַ + מּוֹדָעִי — ha-Moda'i, the Modiite, from Modi'in (gentilic); Kaufmann points it ha-Muda'i
הַמְחַלֵּל: הַ + חִלֵּל — ḥilel, to profane (Piel participle ms); 'one who profanes'
הַקָּדָשִׁים: הַ + קֳדָשִׁים — kodashim, holy things (m. pl. of kodesh); 'sacred offerings'
וְהַמְבַזֶּה: וְ + הַ + בִּזָּה — biza, to despise, treat with contempt (Piel participle ms); 'and one who despises'
הַמּוֹעֲדוֹת: הַ + מוֹעֵד — mo'ed, festival (m. pl. in -ot); 'the festivals'
וְהַמְגַלֶּה: וְ + הַ + גִּלָּה — gila, to uncover (Piel participle ms); מְגַלֶּה פָנִים בַּתּוֹרָה, 'uncovers his face toward the Torah', defies it brazenly
וְהַמֵּפֵר: וְ + הַ + הֵפֵר — hefer, to annul, break (Hifil participle ms); 'and one who annuls'
בְּרִיתוֹ: בְּרִית + ־וֹ — brit, covenant (f.); 'his covenant'. בְּרִיתוֹ שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם, circumcision
וְהַמְּאַדִּים: וְ + הַ + הֶאְדִּים — he'dim, to make red (Hifil participle ms); 'and one who makes (his fellow's face) red', who shames him. Printed editions: הַמַּלְבִּין, 'who makes white'
אַפְ: אַף — af, even, also; אַף עַל פִּי, 'even though'
פִּי: פֶּה — pe, mouth (construct פִּי); עַל פִּי, 'according to'; in אַף עַל פִּי, 'even though'
בְּיָדוֹ: בְּ + יָד + ־וֹ — 'in his hand', i.e. to his credit
לָעוֹלָם: לְ + הָ + עוֹלָם — 'in the world'; הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, 'the world to come'
יִשְׁמָעֵא׳: יִשְׁמָעֵאל (abbr.) — Yishma'el, Ishmael (proper name), written יִשְׁמָעֵא׳
רֹאש: רֹאשׁ — rosh, head; here perhaps a superior. The shin lacks its dot
וְנוֹחַ: וְ + נוֹחַ — noaḥ, easy, accommodating (adj. ms); 'and easy (with)'
תִּישְׁחוֹרֶת: תִּשְׁחֹרֶת — tishḥoret, meaning uncertain: probably youth, the black-haired young (from שָׁחוֹר, 'black'). Spelled with yod
עֲקִיבָה: עֲקִיבָא — Akiva (proper name); Kaufmann spells it with final he
וְקַלּוּת: וְ + קַלּוּת — kalut, lightness (f. construct); קַלּוּת רֹאשׁ, 'lightness of head', levity
מַרְגִּילִים: הִרְגִּיל — hirgil, to accustom, lead on (Hifil participle mpl); 'accustom, draw (a person) on'
לָעֶרְיָה: לְ + הָ + עֶרְוָה — erva, nakedness (f.); forbidden sexual relations; 'to lewdness'. Kaufmann spells it with yod
סְיַיג: סְיָג — siyag, fence (m.). Spelled with double yod
לִפְרִישׁוּת: לִ + פְּרִישׁוּת — prishut, separation, abstinence (f.); 'for abstinence'
שֶׁנִּבְרָא: שֶׁ + נִבְרָא — nivra, to be created (Nifal pf. 3ms); 'that he was created'. The nun was written above the line
בְצֶלֶם: בְּ + צֶלֶם — tselem, image (m.); 'in an image'
חִיבָּה: חִבָּה — ḥiba, love, affection (f.). Spelled with yod
יְתֵירָה: יְתֵרָה — yetera, extra, additional (adj. fs). Spelled with yod
נוֹדַעַת: נוֹדַע — noda, to be made known (Nifal participle fs); 'made known'
עָשָׂה: עָשָׂה — asa, to make (Qal pf. 3ms); 'he made'
שֶׁנִּיקְרְאוּ: שֶׁ + נִקְרָא — nikra, to be called (Nifal pf. 3mpl); 'that they were called'. Spelled with yod
לַמָּקוֹם: לְ + הַ + מָּקוֹם — 'to the Omnipresent'; הַמָּקוֹם, literally 'the Place', is a rabbinic name for God
לְיָ׳י: לְ + יהוה (abbr.) — la-Adonay, 'to the LORD', written לְיָ׳י
שֶׁנִּיתַּן: שֶׁ + נִתַּן — nitan, to be given (Nifal pf. 3ms); 'that there was given'. Spelled with yod
כֶּלִי: כְּלִי — kli, instrument, vessel (m.); Kaufmann points it with segol
נִבְרָא: נִבְרָא — nivra, to be created (Nifal pf. 3ms); 'was created'
נָתַתִּי: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal pf. 1cs); 'I have given'
תּוֹרַתִי: תּוֹרָה + ־ִי — 'my Torah, my teaching'. Kaufmann points the resh with pataḥ
תַּעַזֹבוּ: עָזַב — azav, to forsake (Qal impf. 2mpl); with אַל, 'do not forsake'
צָפוּי: צָפָה — tsafa, to look out, foresee (Qal passive participle ms); 'foreseen'
וְהָרְשׁוּת: וְ + הָ + רְשׁוּת — reshut, permission, freedom (f.); 'and the freedom (to choose)'
נְתוּנָה: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal passive participle fs); 'given'
וּבְטוּב: וּ + בְּ + טוּב — tuv, goodness (m.); 'and with goodness'
נִידוֹן: נִדּוֹן — nidon, judged (Nifal participle ms of din); 'is judged'. Spelled with yod
נָתוּן: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal passive participle ms); 'given'
בַּעֲרָבִים: בַּ + עֲרָבִים — 'on pledges, on surety' (pl.; root ערב, to stand guarantor). Printed editions: בְּעֵרָבוֹן, 'on pledge'
וּמְצוּדָה: וּ + מְצוּדָה — metsuda, net, snare (f.); 'and a net'
פְּרוּשָׂה: פָּרַשׂ — paras, to spread (Qal passive participle fs); 'spread'
אל: עַל — al, over. Unvocalized in the manuscript; spelled with alef for ayin
הַחַיִּים: הַ + חַיִּים — ḥayim, the living (m. pl.); 'all the living'
פְּתוּחָה: פָּתַח — pataḥ, to open (Qal passive participle fs); 'open'
וְהַחַנְוָונִי: וְ + הַ + חֶנְוָנִי — ḥenvani, shopkeeper (m.); 'and the shopkeeper'. Spelled with double vav
מַקִּיף: הִקִּיף — hikif, to give credit (Hifil participle ms); 'gives credit'
הַפִּינְקֵס: הַ + פִּנְקָס — pinkas, ledger, account book (Greek pinax); Kaufmann treats it as feminine
כּוֹתֶבֶת: כָּתַב — katav, to write (Qal participle fs); 'writes'
וְהַגַּבָּאִים: וְ + הַ + גַּבַּאי — gabay, collector (m. pl.); 'and the collectors'
מְחַזְרִים: חִזֵּר — ḥizer, to go round (Piel participle mpl); 'go round, make their rounds'
וְנִפְרָעִין: וְ + נִפְרַע — nifra, to exact payment (Nifal participle mpl, -in); 'and they collect payment'
לְדַעְתּוֹ: לְ + דַּעַת + ־וֹ — da'at, knowledge (f.); 'with his knowledge'. Printed editions: מִדַּעְתּוֹ
וְשֶׁלֹּא: וְ + שֶׁ + לֹּא — 'and without' (שֶׁלֹּא לְדַעְתּוֹ, 'without his knowledge')
מְתוּקָּן: מְתֻקָּן — metukan, prepared, set right (Pual participle ms); 'prepared'
לִסְעוֹדָה: לִ + סְעוּדָה — se'uda, meal, feast (f.); 'for the feast'
יִרְאָה: יִרְאָה — yir'a, fear (f.); here the fear of God
קֶמַח: קֶמַח — kemaḥ, flour (m.); bread, a livelihood
לְמָה: לְ + מָה — 'to what?'; לְמָה הוּא דוֹמֶה, 'what is he like?' — the opening of a parable
דוֹמֶה: דּוֹמֶה — dome, resembling, like (Qal participle ms)
שֶׁנּוֹפוֹ: שֶׁ + נוֹף + ־וֹ — nof, foliage, treetop (m.); 'whose foliage'
מרובה: מְרֻבֶּה — merube, abundant (Pual participle ms); 'is abundant'. Unvocalized in the manuscript; added in the margin
וְשָׁרָשָׁיו: וְ + שֹׁרֶשׁ + ־ָיו — shoresh, root (m. pl. + 3ms suffix); 'and its roots'
מְעוּטִין: מֻעָט — mu'at, few, little (Hofal participle mpl, -in); 'are few'
וְהָרוּחַ: וְ + הָ + רוּחַ — ruaḥ, wind (f.); 'and the wind'
בָּאת: בָּא — ba, to come (Qal participle fs, short spelling of בָּאָה); 'comes'
וְעוֹקְרַתּוּ: וְ + עָקַר + ־וֹ — akar, to uproot (Qal participle fs + 3ms suffix, Kaufmann's -atu); 'and uproots it'. וְעוֹקְ- is a second hand's writing over an erasure
וְהָפְכַתּוּ: וְ + הָפַךְ + ־וֹ — hafakh, to overturn (Qal participle fs + 3ms suffix); 'and overturns it'. A vav after the he was erased
פָּנָיו: פָּנִים + ־ָיו — 'its face'; עַל פָּנָיו, 'flat on its face'
מְרוּבִּין: מְרֻבֶּה — merube, many (Pual participle mpl, -in); 'are more (than)'
מְמוּעָט: מְמֻעָט — memu'at, small, little (Pual participle ms); 'is small'
בָּאוֹת: בָּא — ba, to come (Qal participle fpl); 'come'
מְזִיזוֹת: הֵזִיז — heziz, to move, shift (Hifil participle fpl); 'move'. The final tav is a second hand's writing over an erasure
בִּן: בֶּן — ben, son of; Kaufmann points it with ḥiriq, bin
חֲסָמָה: חִסְמָא — Ḥisma (proper name); Kaufmann spells it Ḥasama, with final he
קִינִּים: קֵן — ken, nest (m. pl.); קִנִּים, 'nests' — pairs of birds brought as offerings, and the tractate on them
נִדָּה: נִדָּה — nida, menstruation, the menstruant woman (f.)
גּוּפֵי: גּוּף — guf, body (m. construct pl.); גּוּפֵי הֲלָכוֹת, 'the bodies of laws', the essentials of halakha
תְּקוּפוֹת: תְּקוּפָה — tkufa, season, cycle (f. pl.); astronomy and calendar reckoning
וְגֵמַטַּרִיָיה: וְ + גֵּימַטְרִיָּא — gematriya, from Greek geometria: geometry, mathematics; 'and geometry'. Spelled with double yod
פַּרְפִּרָיוֹת: פַּרְפֶּרֶת — parperet, side dish, dessert (f. pl.); 'side dishes, sweets (to the meal)'
זוֹמָה: זוֹמָא — Zoma (proper name; Kaufmann spells it with final he); בֶּן זוֹמָא, Ben Zoma — Shimon ben Zoma, always called by his father's name
חָכָם: חָכָם — ḥakham, wise; a sage (adj./n. ms); 'wise'
הַלָּמֵד: הַ + לָמַד — lamad, to learn (Qal participle ms; Kaufmann vocalizes lamed where the printed texts have lomed); 'one who learns'
מִכָּל: מִ + כָּל — 'from every, from all'; also comparative, 'than all'
שֶׁנ׳: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (abbr.) — 'as it is said' (Nifal pf. 3ms), written שֶׁנ׳; introduces a verse
מְלַמְּדַי: לִמֵּד + ־ַי — limmed, to teach (Piel participle mpl + 1cs suffix); 'my teachers' (Ps 119:99)
הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי: הִשְׂכִּיל — hiskil, to gain insight, grow wise (Hifil pf. 1cs); 'I have gained understanding'
אֵיזֶה: אֵיזֶה — which?; אֵיזֶה הוּא, 'which is he', i.e. 'who is…?' (also written as two words, אֵי זֶה)
גִּיבּוֹר: גִּבּוֹר — gibbor, mighty man, warrior (m.); 'mighty'. Spelled with a yod
הַכּוֹבֵשׁ: הַ + כָּבַשׁ — kavash, to subdue, conquer (Qal participle ms); 'one who subdues'
יִצְרוֹ: יֵצֶר + ־וֹ — yetser, inclination, impulse (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'his inclination' — in rabbinic usage, the drive toward wrongdoing
מִגִּבּוֹר: מִ + גִּבּוֹר — 'than a mighty man' (comparative min)
וּמוֹשֵׁל: וּ + מָשַׁל — mashal, to rule (Qal participle ms); 'and one who rules'
בְּרוּחוֹ: בְּ + רוּחַ + ־וֹ — ruaḥ, spirit, temper (f.) + 3ms suffix; 'over his spirit'
מִלֹּכֶד: מִ + לָכַד — lakhad, to capture (Qal participle ms); 'than one who captures'
הַשָּׂמֵחַ: הַ + שָׂמֵחַ — same'aḥ, glad, rejoicing (adj. ms); 'one who rejoices'
בְּחֶלְקוֹ: בְּ + חֵלֶק + ־וֹ — ḥelek, portion, lot (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'in his portion' — content with his lot
יְגִיעַ: יְגִיעַ — yegia, toil; what toil produces (m., construct); 'the toil of'
כַּפֶּיךָ: כַּף + ־יךָ — kaf, palm, hand (f. dual + 2ms suffix); 'your hands'
וְטוֹב: וְ + טוֹב — 'and good'; וְטוֹב לָךְ, 'and it is well with you'
הַמְכַבֵּד: הַ + כִּבֵּד — kibbed, to honour (Piel participle ms); 'one who honours'
מְכַבְּדַי: כִּבֵּד + ־ַי — 'those who honour Me' (Piel participle mpl + 1cs suffix; 1 Sam 2:30)
וּבֹזַיִ: וּ + בָּזָה + ־ַי — baza, to despise (Qal participle mpl + 1cs suffix); 'and those who despise Me'. Kaufmann puts a ḥiriq under the final yod
יקלו: קַל — kal, to be light, of little account (Qal impf. 3mpl, יֵקַלּוּ); 'will be lightly esteemed'. Unvocalized in the manuscript
עַזַּיִי: עַזַּאי — Azzai (proper name); בֶּן עַזַּאי, Ben Azzai — Shimon ben Azzai. Kaufmann writes a double yod
הֱוֵי: הֱוֵי — hevei, be! (Mishnaic imperative 2ms of hava, to be)
רָץ: רוּץ — ruts, to run (Qal participle ms); 'running'
לְמִצְוָה: לְ + מִצְוָה — mitsva, commandment; the good deed of fulfilling one (f.); 'to a commandment'
וּבוֹרֵחַ: וּ + בָּרַח — baraḥ, to flee (Qal participle ms); 'and fleeing'
הַעֲבֵירָה: הָ + עֲבֵירָה — avera, transgression, sin (f.; literally 'a crossing over'); 'the transgression'. Kaufmann vocalizes the article with pataḥ
גוֹרֶרֶת: גָּרַר — garar, to drag, pull along (Qal participle fs); 'drags along, brings in its wake'
שְׁשְׂכַר: שֶׁ + שְׂכַר — sekhar, reward, wages of (m. construct of sakhar); 'for the reward of'. Kaufmann puts a shva under the prefix she-
תְהִי: הָיָה — to be (Qal jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not be'
בָז: בּוּז — buz, to despise, scorn (Qal participle ms); 'scornful (of)'
מַפְלִיג: הִפְלִיג — hiflig, to set far off; to dismiss as remote or impossible (Hifil participle ms); 'dismissive (of)'
רְ׳: רַבִּי (abbr.) — Rabbi, 'my master', title of an ordained sage; written רְ׳
לְוִייטַס: לְוִיטַס — Levitas (proper name); Kaufmann writes a double yod
יַבְנֶה: יַבְנֶה — Yavne (Jamnia), coastal town where the sages regrouped after 70 CE; אִישׁ יַבְנֶה, 'of Yavne'
שְׁפַל: שְׁפַל — shefal, low of (construct of shafal, low); שְׁפַל רוּחַ, 'humble in spirit'
שֶׁתִּקְוַת: שֶׁ + תִּקְוָה — tikva, hope (f. construct); 'for the hope of'
אֱנוֹשׁ: אֱנוֹשׁ — enosh, man, mortal (m.; poetic); אֱנוֹשׁ רִמָּה, 'man is a worm' (Job 25:6)
יוֹחָנַן: יוֹחָנָן — Yoḥanan (proper name); Kaufmann vocalizes the last syllable with pataḥ
בַּסֵּתֶר: בַּ + סֵתֶר — seter, secrecy, a hidden place (m.); 'in secret'
נִפְרָעִים: נִפְרַע — nifra, to exact payment, punish (Nifal participle mpl, impersonal); 'they exact payment' — i.e. he is punished
בַגָּלוּי: בַּ + גָּלוּי — galuy, open, revealed (Qal passive participle); 'in the open, in public'. The בַ was corrected from כ
שׁוֹגֵג: שָׁגַג — shogeg, one who errs unwittingly (Qal participle ms); 'inadvertent'
ואֶחָד: וְ + אֶחָד — 'and one'. The vav was added by a second hand and is unvocalized
מֵזִיד: הֵזִיד — mezid, one who acts wilfully (Hifil participle ms); 'deliberate'
בְּחִילּוּל: בְּ + חִלּוּל — ḥillul, profanation (m. construct); 'in profanation of'
הַשֵּׁם: הַ + שֵּׁם — 'the Name', i.e. God's name; חִלּוּל הַשֵּׁם, profaning God's name
לְלַמֵּד: לְ + לִמֵּד — 'to teach' (Piel inf.). A yod after the lamed was erased
מַסְפִּיקִין: הִסְפִּיק — hispik, to supply, provide enough (Hifil participle mpl, Mishnaic -in; impersonal); מַסְפִּיקִין בְּיָדוֹ, 'they put into his hand the means'
לַעֲשׂוֹת: עָשָׂה — 'to do' (Qal inf.); here, to put into practice
לִשְׁמוֹר: שָׁמַר — shamar, to keep, observe (Qal inf.); 'to keep'. Added in the margin
תַּעֲשֵׂם: עָשָׂה + ־ם — 'make them' (Qal jussive 2ms + 3mpl suffix); with אַל, 'do not make them' — 'them' are the words of Torah
לְהִתְגַּדֵּל: הִתְגַּדֵּל — hitgadel, to make oneself great (Hitpael inf.); 'to exalt yourself'
קוֹרְדּוֹם: קַרְדֹּם — kardom, axe, spade (m.); Kaufmann: kordom
לֹאכַל: אָכַל — 'to eat' (Qal inf., לֶאֱכֹל contracted to lokhal)
וְכָךְ: וְ + כָּךְ — 'and thus, and so'. The final kaf was corrected from nun
וְדִיִשְׁתַּמָּשׁ: וּ + דִּי + אִשְׁתַּמַּשׁ — Aramaic: 'and (he) who makes use of' (Hitpaal impf. 3ms). The vav was added by a second hand; a final nun was erased
הָאכָּל: הָא + כָּל — ha, 'lo, here' (Aramaic) + kol, 'whoever'; 'so whoever'. First written הָאוֹכֵל, 'one who eats'; the vav was erased to make הָא כָּל
הַנֵּאוֹת: הַ + נֵאוֹת — 'who benefits, who has use of', standing where the printed editions have הַנֶּהֱנֶה. Perhaps a Nifal participle of אות (to agree, find agreeable); the form's derivation is uncertain
נָטַל: נָטַל — natal, to take (Qal pf. 3ms); 'has taken'
חַיָּיו: חַיִּים + ־יו — ḥayyim, life (m. pl.) + 3ms suffix; 'his life'. Double yod
גוּפוֹ: גּוּף + ־וֹ — guf, body + 3ms suffix; 'his body', i.e. he himself
מְחוּלָּל: חֻלַּל — meḥulal, profaned, degraded (Pual participle ms)
הָחוֹסֵךְ: הַ + חָשַׂךְ — ḥasakh, to hold back, withhold (Qal participle ms; Mishnaic spelling with samekh); 'one who holds himself back'. The final kaf was corrected from nun
פּוֹרֵק: פָּרַק — parak, to throw off, remove (Qal participle ms); 'rids (himself) of'
וְגָזֵל: וְ + גָּזֵל — gazel, robbery; stolen property (m.); 'and robbery'
וּשְׁבוּעַת: וּ + שְׁבוּעָה — shevu'a, oath (f. construct); 'and an oath of'
שָׁוְא: שָׁוְא — shav, vanity, falsehood (m.); שְׁבוּעַת שָׁוְא, a vain or false oath
וְהַגַּס: וְ + הַ + גַּס — gas, coarse, gross (adj. ms); גַּס לִבּוֹ, 'coarse of heart', arrogant
בַהוֹדָיָה: בַּ + הוֹדָיָה — hodaya, admission, acknowledgment (f.); 'in admission'. The printed editions have בַּהוֹרָאָה, 'in issuing rulings'
וְגַס: וְ + גַּס — 'and coarse'; גַּס רוּחַ, arrogant
יְחִידִי: יְחִידִי — yeḥidi, alone, by oneself (adj. ms). The final yod was added by a second hand
דָּן: דָּן — dan, judging (Qal participle ms of din, to judge)
תֹאמַר: אָמַר — 'you say' (Qal impf. 2ms); with אַל, 'do not say'
קַבְּלוּ: קִבֵּל — 'accept!' (Piel imperative mpl). A yod was erased (first written קיבלו)
דַעְתִּי: דַּעַת + ־ִי — da'at, opinion, mind (f.) + 1cs suffix; 'my opinion'
שֶׁהֶן: שֶׁ + הֵן — 'for they' (Mishnaic הֵן for הֵם). Written over an erasure
רַשַּׁיִין: רַשַּׁאי — rashai, entitled, permitted (adj. mpl, Mishnaic -in); 'entitled (to decide)'. Kaufmann spells it with double yod
הַמְקַיֵּים: הַ + קִיֵּם — kiyyem, to fulfil, uphold (Piel participle ms); 'one who fulfils'. Double yod
מֵעוֹנִי: מֵ + עֹנִי — oni, poverty (m.); 'out of poverty', in the midst of it
סוֹפוֹ: סוֹף + ־וֹ — 'his end'; סוֹפוֹ לְ…, 'he will end up …'
לְקַיְּימָה: לְ + קִיֵּם + ־ָהּ — 'to fulfil it' (Piel inf. + 3fs suffix; 'it' = the Torah)
מֵעוֹשֶׁר: מֵ + עֹשֶׁר — osher, wealth (m.); 'out of wealth'
הַמְבַטֵּל: הַ + בִּטֵּל — bittel, to neglect, set aside (Piel participle ms); 'one who neglects'
לְבָטְלָה: לְ + בִּטֵּל + ־ָהּ — 'to neglect it' (Piel inf. + 3fs suffix)
וַעֲסוֹק: וַ + עָסַק — asak, to occupy oneself with (Qal imperative ms); 'and occupy yourself'
וּשְׁפַל: וּ + שְׁפַל — 'and low of'; שְׁפַל רוּחַ, humble
בָּטַלְתָּה: בָּטֵל — batel, to be idle, neglect (Qal pf. 2ms; Kaufmann adds a final he); 'you have neglected'
יֶשׁ: יֵשׁ — yesh, there is; יֵשׁ לִי, 'I have'
לי: לְ + ־ִי — 'for me'; יֵשׁ לִי, 'I have'. Unvocalized here; the yod was corrected from vav (לוֹ, 'he has')
בְטֵלִים: בָּטֵל — batel, idle (adj. mpl); 'idle things' — distractions and hindrances
עָמַלְתָּה: עָמַל — amal, to toil (Qal pf. 2ms, with final he); 'you have toiled'
לִיתֶּן: נָתַן — 'to give' (Qal inf. לִתֵּן, spelled with yod)
הָעוֹשֶׂה: הָ + עָשָׂה — 'one who does, performs' (Qal participle ms)
פְּרַקְלִיט: פְּרַקְלִיט — praklit, advocate, defence counsel (m.; from Greek paraklētos)
הָעוֹבֵר: הָ + עָבַר — avar, to pass over; with עֲבֵירָה, to commit (Qal participle ms); 'one who commits'
קָטֵיגוֹר: קָטֵגוֹר — kategor, accuser, prosecutor (m.; from Greek katēgoros)
וּמַעֲשִׂים: וּ + מַעֲשֶׂה — ma'ase, deed (m. pl.); 'and deeds'
כִּתְרִיס: כְּ + תְּרִיס — tris, shield (m.; from Greek thyreos); 'like a shield'
הַסַּנְדַּלָר: הַ + סַנְדְּלָר — sandlar, sandal-maker (m.; from Greek sandalion); Kaufmann: sandalar
כְּנֵסְיָיה: כְּנֵסִיָּה — kenesiya, gathering, assembly (f.); spelled with double yod
לְשֵׁום: לְ + שֵׁם — 'for the name of'; לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם, 'for the sake of Heaven'. Written with an extra vav
לְהִתְקַיֵּים: הִתְקַיֵּם — hitkayem, to endure, last (Hitpael inf.); 'to endure'. Double yod
וְשֶׁאֵינָה: וְ + שֶׁ + אֵין + ־ָהּ — 'and (one) that is not'
לְהִיתְקַיֵּים: הִתְקַיֵּם — 'to endure' (Hitpael inf., spelled with yod after the he)
כְּמוֹרָא: כְּ + מוֹרָא — 'like the reverence of, like the fear of'
בַּתַּלְמוּד: בַּ + תַּלְמוּד — talmud, study, learning (m.); 'in study'
שֶׁשִׁיגְגַת: שֶׁ + שְׁגָגָה — shegaga, unwitting error (f. construct; Kaufmann shigegat); 'for an error of'. Corrected by a second hand from ששיגת
עוֹלָה: עָלָה — ala, to go up; to count as (Qal participle fs); 'counts as'
זָדוֹן: זָדוֹן — zadon, wilful wrongdoing (m.); 'a deliberate sin'
כֶּתֶר: כֶּתֶר — keter, crown (m.; construct); 'the crown of'
גַּבֵּיהֶן: גַּב + ־יהֶן — gav, back (m. pl. + 3mpl suffix, Mishnaic -hen); עַל גַּבֵּיהֶן, 'on their backs', above them
נְהוֹרַיִי: נְהוֹרַאי — Nehorai (proper name); Kaufmann writes a double yod
תֹּאמַר: אָמַר — 'you say' (Qal impf. 2ms). A vav was erased after the tav
אַחֲרַיִי: אַחֲרֵי + ־ַי — 'after me'; Kaufmann writes a double yod
שֶׁחֲבֵירֶיךָ: שֶׁ + חֲבֵרִים + ־יךָ — ḥaver, companion (m. pl. + 2ms suffix); 'for your companions'. The yod before the suffix was added by a second hand
יתקַיְּימוּהָ: קִיֵּם + ־הָ — 'they will establish it, make it secure' (Piel impf. 3mpl + 3fs suffix, as the printed יְקַיְּמוּהָ). Kaufmann has an extra tav; the first two letters are unvocalized
תִּישָּׁעֵן: נִשְׁעַן — nish'an, to lean, rely (Nifal jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not lean' (Prov 3:5)
בְּיָדֵינוּ: בְּ + יָד + ־ֵינוּ — 'in our hands'; אֵין בְּיָדֵינוּ, 'it is not in our grasp'
מִשַּׁלְוַות: מִ + שַׁלְוָה — shalva, ease, tranquillity (f. construct); 'of the ease of'. Double vav
מִיִּסּוּרֵיהֶן: מִ + יִסּוּרִים + ־יהֶן — yissurim, sufferings (m. pl.) + 3mpl suffix (-hen); 'of their sufferings'
שֶׁלַצַּדִּיקִים: שֶׁל + הַ + צַדִּיקִים — 'of the righteous'; שֶׁל joined to the noun, absorbing the he of the article (shela-)
מַקְדִּים: הִקְדִּים — hikdim, to be first, do early (Hifil participle ms); 'first (to)'
לִשְׁלוֹם: לִ + שְׁלוֹם — shalom, greeting, welfare (m. construct); 'to the greeting of'
לָאֲרָיוֹת: לְ + הָ + אֲרָיוֹת — ari, lion (pl.); 'to the lions'
לַשּׁוּעָלִים: לְ + הַ + שׁוּעָלִים — shu'al, fox, jackal (m. pl.); 'to the foxes'
דּוֹמֶה: דָּמָה — dome, resembling, like (Qal participle ms)
לִפְרוֹזְדּוֹר: לִ + פְּרוֹזְדּוֹר — 'at the vestibule'. The final resh was corrected, as above
כְּדֵי: כְּדֵי — kedei, in order; כְּדֵי שֶׁ…, 'so that'. Added in the margin
שֶׁתִּיכָּנֵס: שֶׁ + נִכְנַס — nikhnas, to enter (Nifal impf. 2ms); 'that you may enter'
לִיטְרִיקְלִין: לְ + טְרַקְלִין — traklin, banquet hall, dining room (m.; from Greek triklinion); 'into the banquet hall'. Kaufmann: triklin
יָפָה: יָפֶה — yafe, fair, good; with מִן, 'better than'
הַעוֹלָם: הָ + עוֹלָם — 'the world' (Kaufmann vocalizes the article with pataḥ)
שֶׁלְקוֹרַת: שֶׁל + קוֹרַת — korat, coolness of (f. construct of kora); קוֹרַת רוּחַ, 'coolness of spirit', contentment
תְּרַצֵּה: רִצָּה — ritsa, to appease, placate (Piel jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not appease'
כַּעסוֹ: כַּעַס + ־וֹ — ka'as, anger (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'his anger'. The ayin is unvocalized
תְּנַחֲמֶנּוּ: נִחֵם + ־נּוּ — niḥem, to comfort (Piel jussive 2ms + 3ms suffix); 'comfort him'
שֶׁמֵּתוֹ: שֶׁ + מֵת + ־וֹ — met, dead person + 3ms suffix; 'when his dead'
מוּטַל: הוּטַל — mutal, laid down, lying (Hofal participle ms)
תִּשְׁאַל: שָׁאַל — sha'al, to ask (Qal jussive 2ms); שָׁאַל לְ…, 'to ask for (someone)' — here, to seek release from a vow on his behalf
תִּשְׁתַּדֵּל: הִשְׁתַּדֵּל — hishtadel, to strive, try (Hitpael jussive 2ms); 'try'. The second half of the word is a correction
קַלְקַלָתוֹ: קַלְקָלָה + ־וֹ — kalkala, disgrace, downfall (f.) + 3ms suffix; 'his disgrace'
שְמוּאֵ׳: שְׁמוּאֵל (abbr.) — Shmuel, Samuel (proper name), written שְמוּאֵ׳
הַקָּטָן: הַ + קָּטָן — katan, small (adj. ms); 'the Small' — Samuel's epithet
בִּנְפוֹל: בִּ + נָפַל — nafal, to fall (Qal inf.); 'when (he) falls'
תִּשְׂמַח: שָׂמַח — samaḥ, to rejoice (Qal jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not rejoice'
וּבְהִכָּשְׁלוֹ: וּ + בְּ + נִכְשַׁל + ־וֹ — nikhshal, to stumble (Nifal inf. + 3ms suffix); 'and when he stumbles'
יָגֵל: גִּיל — gil, to exult (Qal jussive 3ms); with אַל, 'let (it) not exult'
אֲבִייָּה: אֲבוּיָה — Avuya (proper name); Kaufmann: Aviya, with double yod
לִדְיוֹ: לִ + דְּיוֹ — dyo, ink (here f.); 'to ink'. In the first occurrence written over an erasure by a second hand; in the second, added in the margin
כְתוּבָה: כָּתַב — ketuva, written (Qal passive participle fs)
נְיָיר: נְיָר — niyar, paper, papyrus (m.); spelled with double yod
זָקֵן: זָקֵן — zaken, old man (m.); 'as an old man'
מָחוּק: מָחַק — maḥuk, erased, scraped (Qal passive participle ms) — of a sheet scraped clean for reuse
הַבַּבְלִי: הַ + בַּבְלִי — Bavli, Babylonian (gentilic adj.); כְּפַר הַבַּבְלִי, Kefar ha-Bavli, 'the Babylonian's Village'
הַקְּטָנִים: הַ + קְּטַנִּים — katan, small; here 'the young' (m. pl.)
לְאוֹכֵל: לְ + אָכַל — 'to one who eats' (Qal participle ms)
קֵיהוֹת: קֵהֶה — keheh, blunted; of grapes, sour, unripe (adj. f. pl.) — the kind that set the teeth on edge
מִגִּיתּוֹ: מִ + גַּת + ־וֹ — gat, winepress, vat (f.) + 3ms suffix; 'from its vat' — wine still raw
וְהַלָּמֵד: וְ + הַ + לָמַד — 'and one who learns' (Qal participle ms)
הַזְּקֵנִים: הַ + זְּקֵנִים — zaken, old man, elder (m. pl.); 'the old'
לְאֹכֵל: לְ + אָכַל — 'to one who eats' (defective spelling; a vav was erased)
תִּיסְתַּכֵּל: הִסְתַּכֵּל — histakel, to look at, gaze (Hitpael jussive 2ms); with אַל, 'do not look'
בַּקִּינְקֵן: בַּ + קַנְקַן — kankan, earthenware jug (m.); 'at the jug'. Kaufmann: kinkan
שֶׁיֶּש: שֶׁ + יֵשׁ — 'that there is' (the shin of yesh lacks its dot)
יֵש: יֵשׁ — 'there is' (the shin lacks its dot)
הַכַּפָּר: הַ + קַּפָּר — ha-Kappar, epithet of R. Elazar; its meaning is uncertain
וְהַתַּאֲוָה: וְ + הַ + תַּאֲוָה — ta'ava, desire, lust (f.); 'and desire'
וְהַכָּבוֹד: וְ + הַ + כָּבוֹד — kavod, honour (m.); 'and (the pursuit of) honour'
הַיִּלּוֹדִים: הַ + יִלּוֹד — yillod, born (adj. m. pl.); 'those who are born'
לָמוּת: מוּת — mut, to die (Qal inf.); 'to die'
וְהַמֵּתִים: וְ + הַ + מֵּתִים — met, dead (m. pl.); 'and the dead'
לִחְיוֹת: חָיָה — ḥaya, to live (Qal inf.); 'to live (again)'
וְהַחַיִּים: וְ + הַ + חַיִּים — ḥai, living (m. pl.); 'and the living'
לִידּוֹן: נִדּוֹן — nidon, to be judged (Nifal inf., Mishnaic לִידּוֹן for לְהִדּוֹן); 'to be judged'
לֵידָע: יָדַע — 'to know' (Qal inf., Mishnaic form for לָדַעַת)
וּלְהוֹדִיַע: וּ + הוֹדִיעַ — hodia, to make known (Hifil inf.); 'and to make known'. The vav was added by a second hand
וּלְהִיוָּודַע: וּ + נוֹדַע — noda, to become known (Nifal inf.); 'and to be made known'. Spelled with a double vav
הַיּוֹצֵר: הַ + יָצַר — yotser, the Former, Maker (Qal participle ms)
הַבּוֹרֵא: הַ + בָּרָא — bore, the Creator (Qal participle ms)
הַמֵּבִין: הַ + הֵבִין — mevin, the one who understands, discerns (Hifil participle ms)
הַדַּיָּין: הַ + דַּיָּן — dayyan, judge (m.); 'the Judge'. Double yod
לָדוֹן: דִּין — din, to judge (Qal inf.); 'to judge'
מְשׂוֹא: מַשּׂוֹא — masso, lifting, regard (m. construct); מַשּׂוֹא פָנִים, 'lifting of face' — favouritism. Kaufmann: meso
מַקַּח: מִקָּח — mikkaḥ, taking (m. construct; Kaufmann makkaḥ); מַקַּח שֹׁחַד, 'taking a bribe'
בְחֶשְׁבּוֹן: בְּ + חֶשְׁבּוֹן — ḥeshbon, account, reckoning (m.); 'by reckoning'
יַבְטִיחָךְ: הִבְטִיחַ + ־ךָ — hivtiaḥ, to assure, promise (Hifil jussive 3ms + 2ms suffix -akh); with אַל, 'let (it) not assure you'
שֶׁהַשְּׁאוֹל: שֶׁ + הַ + שְּׁאוֹל — she'ol, Sheol, the underworld, the grave (f.); 'that the grave'
מָנוֹס: מָנוֹס — manos, refuge, escape (m.); בֵּית מָנוֹס, 'a house of refuge'
שֶׁעַל: שֶׁ + עַל — 'for … on'; שֶׁעַל כָּרְחָךְ, 'for against your will'
כָּרְחָךְ: כֹּרַח + ־ךָ — koraḥ, compulsion (m.) + 2ms suffix; עַל כָּרְחָךְ, 'against your will'. A vav was erased in every occurrence
נוֹצָר: נוֹצַר — notsar, to be formed (Nifal participle ms); 'you are formed'
נוֹלַד: נוֹלַד — nolad, to be born (Nifal participle/pf. 3ms); 'you are born'
חַיִ: חַי — ḥai, alive; living (adj. ms); 'you live'. Kaufmann puts a ḥiriq under the final yod
מֵת: מֵת — met, dying, dead (Qal participle ms of mut); 'you die'
הַקָּבָּ״הֻ: הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא (abbr.) — ha-Kadosh barukh hu, the Holy One, blessed be He; written הקב״ה, with the scribe's vowel marks on the letters
בַּעֲשָׂרָה: בְּ + עֲשָׂרָה — asara, ten (with m. noun); 'by ten, through ten'
מַאֲמָרוֹת: מַאֲמָר — ma'amar, saying, utterance (m. pl. with -ot); 'utterances' — God's creating words in Genesis 1
וַהֲלֹא: וַ + הֲ + לֹא — 'and is it not (so that)…?', opening a rhetorical question
לְהִיבָּרוֹת: לְ + נִבְרָא — to be created (Nifal inf. of bara); 'to be created'
לְהִיפָּרַע: לְ + נִפְרַע — nifra, to exact payment, punish (Nifal inf. of para); with מִן, 'to collect payment from'
מְאַבְּדִין: אִבֵּד — ibed, to destroy (Piel participle mpl, Mishnaic -in); 'destroy'
בַעֲשָׂרָה: בְּ + עֲשָׂרָה — 'by ten' (spirant bet after a vowel)
וְלִיתֵּן: וְ + לִתֵּן — liten, to give (Mishnaic inf. of natan); 'and to give'. Spelled with yod
לַצַּדִּיקִים: לְ + הַ + צַדִּיק — tsadik, righteous man (m. pl.); 'to the righteous'
מְקַיְּימִים: קִיֵּם — kiyem, to sustain, uphold (Piel participle mpl); 'sustain'. Spelled with double yod
שֶׁנִבְרָא: שֶׁ + נִבְרָא — 'that was created' (as above, without the dagesh)
מֵאָדָם: מִ + אָדָם — Adam, the first man (proper name); 'from Adam'
וְעַד: וְ + עַד — 'and until'; מִ… וְעַד, 'from … to'
נֹוַח: נֹחַ — Noaḥ, Noah (proper name); also the adjective noaḥ, easy (5:11 'easy to anger'). Kaufmann writes a vav after the ḥolam
לְהוֹדִיַע: לְהוֹדִיעַ — lehodia, to make known (Hifil inf. of yada); 'to show'. Kaufmann puts the furtive pataḥ under the yod
כַּמָּה: כַּמָּה — kama, how much, how great
מַכְעִיסִים: הִכְעִיס — hikh'is, to provoke, anger (Hifil participle mpl); הָיוּ מַכְעִיסִים, 'kept provoking'
שֶׁהֵבִיא: שֶׁ + הֵבִיא — hevi, to bring (Hifil pf. 3ms); עַד שֶׁהֵבִיא, 'until He brought'
עֲשָׁרָה: עֲשָׂרָה — asara, ten; written here with a shin dot for the sin
מִנֹּוַח: מִ + נֹחַ — 'from Noah'. Kaufmann's spelling with vav
אֲבִינוּ: אָבִינוּ — avinu, 'our father' (av + 1cpl suffix), vocalized here with ḥataf-pataḥ
שֶׁבָּא: שֶׁ + בָּא — ba, to come (Qal pf. 3ms); עַד שֶׁבָּא, 'until (he) came'
וְקִיבֵּל: וְ + קִבֵּל — kibel, to receive (Piel pf. 3ms); 'and received'
שְׂכַר: שָׂכָר — sakhar, reward, wages (m. construct); 'the reward of'
נִיסְיוֹנוֹת: נִסָּיוֹן — nisayon, trial, test (m. pl. with -ot); 'trials'
מִתְנַסָּה: נִתְנַסָּה — mitnase, to be tested (Hitpael participle ms); 'is tested'. The printed texts have the perfect נִתְנַסָּה, 'was tested'
וְעָמַד: וְ + עָמַד — amad, to stand (Qal pf. 3ms); עָמַד בְּ, 'withstood'
חִיבָּתוֹ: חִבָּה + ־וֹ — ḥiba, affection, love (f.) + 3ms suffix; 'the love of him'
שֶׁלְּאַבְרָהָם: שֶׁל + אַבְרָהָם — Avraham, Abraham (proper name); 'of Abraham'. Kaufmann joins שֶׁל to the next word
נֶעֱשׂוּ: נַעֲשָׂה — na'asa, to be done (Nifal pf. 3mpl of asa); 'were done'
לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ: לְ + אָבוֹת + ־ֵינוּ — avot, fathers (pl. of av); 'for our fathers, for our ancestors'
וַעֲשָׁרָה: וַ + עֲשָׂרָה — 'and ten' (shin dot written for the sin)
הַיָּם: הַ + יָם — yam, sea (m.); here the Sea of Reeds
הַמִּצְרִיִּים: הַ + מִצְרִי — Mitsri, Egyptian (gentilic, m. pl.); 'the Egyptians'
בַּמִּדְבָּר: בְּ + הַ + מִדְבָּר — midbar, wilderness (m.); 'in the wilderness'
וַיְנַסּוּ: וַ + נִסָּה — 'and they tested' (Piel impf. 3mpl with consecutive vav; biblical form, Numbers 14:22)
פְּעָמִים: פַּעַם — pa'am, time, occurrence (f. pl.); זֶה עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים, 'these ten times'
שָׁמְעוּ: שָׁמַע — shama, to hear (Qal pf. 3mpl); שָׁמַע בְּקוֹל, 'obey'
בְּקוֹלִי: בְּ + קוֹל + ־ִי — kol, voice (m.); 'to my voice'
בְּבֵית: בְּ + בֵּית — 'in the house of'; בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, 'the Temple'
הִפִּילָה: הִפִּיל — hipil, to miscarry, literally 'to make fall' (Hifil pf. 3fs of nafal); 'miscarried'
מֵרֵיַח: מִ + רֵיחַ — re'aḥ, smell (m. construct); 'from the smell of'. Furtive pataḥ written under the yod
בְּשַׂר: בָּשָׂר — basar, meat, flesh (m. construct); 'meat of'
קוֹדֶש: קֹדֶשׁ — kodesh, holiness; בְּשַׂר קֹדֶשׁ, 'holy meat', i.e. sacrificial meat. Shin written without its dot
הִיסְרִיַח: הִסְרִיחַ — hisriaḥ, to go putrid, stink (Hifil pf. 3ms); 'went bad'. Written over an erasure
אֵירַע: אֵרַע — eira, to happen, befall (Piel pf. 3ms)
קֶרִי: קֶרִי — keri, seminal emission (m.), which made a man ritually impure
גָּדוֹל: גָּדוֹל — gadol, great (adj. ms); after kohen, 'high (priest)'
הַכִּיפּוּרִים: הַ + כִּפּוּרִים — kipurim, atonement (m. pl.); יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, 'the Day of Atonement'
נִרְאָה: נִרְאָה — nir'a, to be seen (Nifal pf. 3ms of ra'a); 'was seen'
המטבחים: הַ + מִטְבָּחַיִם — mitbaḥayim, slaughter-place (pl.); בֵּית הַמִּטְבָּחַיִם, the Temple's slaughtering area. Unvocalized in the manuscript; added in the margin by a second hand
נִימְצָא: נִמְצָא — nimtsa, to be found (Nifal pf. 3ms); 'was found'
בַּעוֹמֶר: בְּ + הָ + עֹמֶר — omer, sheaf; the barley offering brought at Passover (Lev 23:10); 'in the Omer'
וּבִשְׁתֵּי: וּ + בְּ + שְׁתֵּי — shtei, two (f. construct); שְׁתֵּי הַלֶּחֶם, 'the two loaves' of Shavuot (Lev 23:17)
וּבְלֶחֶם: וּ + בְּ + לֶחֶם — 'and in the bread of'
הַפָּנִים: הַ + פָּנִים — panim, face, presence; לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים, 'the bread of the Presence', the showbread (Lev 24:5–9)
הַמַּעֲרָכָה: הַ + מַעֲרָכָה — ma'arakha, the arranged pile of wood on the altar (f.)
נָצְחָה: נָצַח — natsaḥ, to overcome, defeat (Qal pf. 3fs); 'overcame'. A yod after the nun was erased
עשָׁן: עָשָׁן — ashan, smoke (m.); עַמּוּד עָשָׁן, 'the pillar of smoke'. The ayin is unvocalized; a he ('the smoke') added in the margin was erased
צְפוּפִין: צָפוּף — tsafuf, crowded, pressed together (adj. pl., Mishnaic -in)
וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים: וּ + הִשְׁתַּחֲוָה — hishtaḥava, to bow down, prostrate oneself (participle mpl); 'and bowing down'
רִווּחִים: רְוָחִים — open spaces (m. pl.), vocalized rivuḥim; 'with room to spare'. Rewritten by a second hand over an erasure
הִיזִּיק: הִזִּיק — hizik, to harm, do damage (Hifil pf. 3ms)
בִּירוּשָׁלִַם: בְּ + יְרוּשָׁלַיִם — 'in Jerusalem'. Kaufmann points the lamed with both ḥiriq and pataḥ, for the ending written without yod
לַחֲבֵירוֹ: לְ + חָבֵר + ־וֹ — ḥaver, fellow (m.); 'to his fellow'
צַר: צַר — tsar, narrow, tight (adj. ms); צַר לִי, 'it is too tight for me'
שֶׁאָלִין: שֶׁ + אָלִין — lin, to lodge, stay the night (Qal impf. 1cs); 'that I may lodge'
נִבְרְאוּ: נִבְרָא — nivra, to be created (Nifal pf. 3mpl); 'were created'
הַשְּׁמָשׁוֹת: הַ + שְּׁמָשׁוֹת — shemesh, sun (pl.); בֵּין הַשְּׁמָשׁוֹת, 'between the suns', twilight
וּפִי: וּ + פִּי — pi, mouth of (construct of pe); 'and the mouth of'
הָאָתוֹן: הָ + אָתוֹן — aton, she-ass (f.); 'the donkey' — Balaam's
וְהַקֶּשֶׁת: וְ + הַ + קֶּשֶׁת — keshet, bow (f.); here the rainbow
וְהַמַּטֶּה: וְ + הַ + מַּטֶּה — mate, staff, rod (m.); Moses' staff
וְהַשָּׁמִיר: וְ + הַ + שָּׁמִיר — shamir, in rabbinic legend a creature that cut stone (biblical 'flint, adamant')
וְהַכְּתָב: וְ + הַ + כְּתָב — ktav, writing, script (m.)
וְהַמִּכְתָּב: וְ + הַ + מִּכְתָּב — mikhtav, writing, inscription (m.; Exod 32:16)
וְהַלֻּחוֹת: וְ + הַ + לֻּחוֹת — luḥot, tablets (pl. of luaḥ); the Tablets of the Covenant
וְיֵשׁ: וְ + יֵשׁ — 'and there are'; וְיֵשׁ אוֹמְרִים, 'and some say'
אוֹמְ׳: אוֹמְרִים (abbr.) — omrim, saying (Qal participle mpl), written אוֹמְ׳; יֵשׁ אוֹמְרִים, 'some say'
הַמַּזִּיקִין: הַ + מַזִּיק — mazik, harmful one, demon (Hifil participle used as noun, m. pl., -in); 'the demons'. The he is a raised letter
וּקְבוּרָתוֹ: וּ + קְבוּרָה + ־וֹ — kvura, burial, grave (f.); 'and his grave'
שֶׁלְמֹשֶׁה: שֶׁל + מֹשֶׁה — 'of Moses' (joined; lamed without dagesh)
צָבָת: צְבָת — tsvat, tongs (f.); Kaufmann vocalizes tsavat, a corrected reading
הָעֲשׂוּיָה: הָ + עָשׂוּי — asui, made (Qal passive participle fs of asa); 'made'. The he is a raised letter
בַּגּוֹלֶם: בְּ + הַ + גֹּלֶם — golem, shapeless lump, raw material; a crude, uncultivated person
בֶחָכָם: בְּ + הֶ + חָכָם — ḥakham, wise man; 'in the wise man'
