מְדַבֵּר: דִּבֵּר — diber, to speak (Piel participle ms); 'speaks'
גָדוֹל: גָּדוֹל — gadol, great; with מִמֶּנּוּ, 'greater than he'
נִכְנַס: נִכְנַס — nikhnas, to enter (Nifal participle ms); נִכְנָס לְתוֹךְ דִּבְרֵי, 'break in on (someone's) words'
לְתוֹךְ: לְ + תוֹךְ — tokh, midst; 'into the midst of'
נִבְהַל: נִבְהַל — nivhal, hasty, rushed (Nifal participle ms); 'hasty'
לְהָשִׁיב: לְ + הֵשִׁיב — heshiv, to answer, reply (Hifil inf. of shuv)
כַּהֲלָכָה: כְּ + הֲלָכָה — halakha, law, ruling (f.); 'according to the law, to the point'
וּמֵשִׁיב: וּ + מֵשִׁיב — meshiv, answering (Hifil participle ms); 'and answers'
כָּעִינְיָן: כְּ + הָ + עִנְיָן — inyan, matter, subject (m.); 'to the point, relevantly'
וְאוֹמֵ׳: וְ + אוֹמֵר (abbr.) — ve-omer, 'and says' (Qal participle ms), written וְאוֹמֵ׳
שֶּׁלֹּא: שֶׁ + לֹּא — 'that not'; מָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׁמַע, 'what he did not hear'
שָׁמַע: שָׁמַע — shama, to hear (Qal pf. 3ms); 'he heard'
שָׁמַעְתִּי: שָׁמַע — shama, to hear (Qal pf. 1cs); 'I heard'
וּמוֹדֶה: וּ + הוֹדָה — hoda, to admit, concede (Hifil participle ms); מוֹדֶה עַל, 'admits'
וְחִילּוּפֵיהֶן: וְ + חִלּוּף + ־ֵיהֶן — ḥiluf, reverse, opposite (m. pl.) + 3mpl suffix (Mishnaic -hen); 'and their opposites'
מִינֵי: מִין — min, kind, species (m. construct pl.); 'kinds of'
בָּאִים: בָּא — ba, to come (Qal participle mpl); 'come'
גוּפֵי: גּוּף — guf, body (m. construct pl.); גּוּפֵי עֲבֵירוֹת, 'main kinds of transgression'
מִקְצָתָן: מִקְצָת + ־ָן — miktsat, part, some; 'some of them' (Mishnaic -an)
מְעַשְּׂרִין: עִשֵּׂר — iser, to tithe (Piel participle mpl, -in); 'tithe'
שֶׁלַּבַּצּוֹרֶת: שֶׁל + הַ + בַּצֹּרֶת — batsoret, drought (f.); 'of drought'. The final tav was corrected from he
בָּא: בָּא — ba, to come (Qal participle ms); 'comes'
גָּמְרוּ: גָּמַר — gamar, to decide, resolve (Qal pf. 3mpl); 'resolved'
שֶׁלִּמְהוּמָה: שֶׁל + מְהוּמָה — mehuma, tumult, turmoil (f.); 'of turmoil'
וְשֶׁלַּבַּצּוֹרֶת: וְ + שֶׁל + הַ + בַּצֹּרֶת — 'and of drought'. The final tav was corrected from he
שֶּלֹּא: שֶׁ + לֹּא — 'not (to)' (shin written without its dot)
לִיטּוֹל: לִטֹּל — litol, to take (Mishnaic inf. of natal); 'to take (off)'
חַלָּה: חַלָּה — ḥala, dough-offering, the portion of dough given to a priest (f.; Num 15:20)
שֶׁלְּכַלָּיָה: שֶׁל + כְּלָיָה — kelaya, annihilation, destruction (f.); 'of annihilation'
המִּיתוֹת: הַ + מִיתָה — mita, death; here death penalty (f. pl.). The he is unvocalized in the manuscript
הָאֲמוּרוֹת: אָמוּר — amur, stated, said (Qal passive participle fpl); 'that are stated'
נִימְסְרוּ: נִמְסַר — nimsar, to be handed over (Nifal pf. 3pl); 'were handed over'
לְבֵית: לְ + בֵית — 'to the house of'; בֵּית דִּין, 'a court'
פֵּירוֹת: פֵּרוֹת — peirot, fruits, produce (pl. of peri, construct)
שְׁבִיעִית: שְׁבִיעִית — shvi'it, the seventh (year): the Sabbatical year
בָּאָה: בָּאָה — ba'a, coming (Qal participle fs of ba); 'comes'. The final he is a raised letter
עִינּוּי: עִנּוּי — inuy, affliction (m.); עִנּוּי הַדִּין, 'delay of justice'
הַמּוֹרִים: הַ + מּוֹרֶה — moreh, one who teaches, gives a ruling (Hifil participle mpl of hora); 'those who teach'
בָאָה: בָּאָה — 'comes' (as above). The final he is a raised letter
לַעוֹלָם: לְ + הָ + עוֹלָם — 'to the world', vocalized here with pataḥ
שְׁבוּעַת: שְׁבוּעָה — shvu'a, oath (f. construct); שְׁבוּעַת שָׁוְא, 'a vain oath, a false oath'
חִילּוּל: חִלּוּל — ḥilul, profanation (m.); חִלּוּל הַשֵּׁם, 'profanation of the Name'
עֲבוֹדָה: עֲבוֹדָה — avoda, worship (f.); עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה, 'strange worship', idolatry
גִּילּוּי: גִּלּוּי — gilui, uncovering (m. construct); גִּלּוּי עֲרָיוֹת, forbidden sexual unions
שְׁפִיכוּת: שְׁפִיכוּת — shfikhut, shedding, spilling (f. construct); שְׁפִיכוּת דָּמִים, 'bloodshed'
הַשְׁמֵט: הַשְׁמֵט — hashmet, release (Hifil inf. of shamat, used as a noun); 'the release (of the land)', the Sabbatical rest. The printed texts have שְׁמִטַּת
בְּאַרְבָּעָה: בְּ + אַרְבָּעָה — arba'a, four (with m. noun); 'at four'
מְרוּבֶּה: מְרֻבֶּה — merube, increased, plentiful (Pual participle ms)
בָּרְבִיעִית: בְּ + הָ + רְבִיעִית — revi'it, fourth (year); 'in the fourth (year)'
וּבַשְׁבִיעִית: וּ + בְּ + הַ + שְׁבִיעִית — 'and in the seventh (year)'. The vav is a raised letter
ובְמוֹצָאֵי: וּ + בְּ + מוֹצָאֵי — motsa'ei, the going-out of, the close of (construct pl.); 'and at the close of'. The vav was added by a second hand, without its point
הֶחָג: הֶ + חָג — ḥag, festival (m.); 'the Festival', Sukkot
שֶׁבְּכָל: שֶׁ + בְּ + כָל — 'that is in every'
שֶׁבַּשְּׁלִישִׁית: שֶׁ + בְּ + הַ + שְּׁלִישִׁית — shlishit, third (year); 'that is in the third (year)'
בַּשְּׁבִיעִית: בְּ + הַ + שְּׁבִיעִית — 'in the seventh (year)'. Written over an erasure
מַעֲשֵׂר: מַעֲשֵׂר — ma'aser, tithe (m. construct); 'the tithe of'
שֶׁבַּשִּׁישִּׁית: שֶׁ + בְּ + הַ + שִּׁשִּׁית — shishit, sixth (year); 'that is in the sixth (year)'. Spelled with yod
מַתְּנוֹת: מַתָּנָה — matana, gift (f. pl. construct); מַתְּנוֹת עֲנִיִּים, the gleanings, forgotten sheaves and field-corners left for the poor
מִידּוֹת: מִדָּה — mida, measure; type, trait (f. pl.)
מִידָּה: מִדָּה — mida, measure, type, trait (f.); in 5:22 'quality, portion'
מִידַּת: מִדָּה — mida (f. construct); 'the trait of, the way of'
בַּדֵּעוֹת: בְּ + הַ + דֵּעָה — de'a, mind, disposition (f. pl.); 'among temperaments'
וְנֹוַח: וְ + נֹחַ — noaḥ, easy (adj. ms); 'and easy'. Spelled with vav as in 5:2
לִרְצוֹת: רָצָה — ratsa, to be reconciled, appeased (Qal inf.); 'to be appeased'
יָצָא: יָצָא — yatsa, to go out (Qal pf. 3ms); יָצָא שְׂכָרוֹ בְּהֶפְסֵדוֹ, 'his gain is cancelled by his loss'
בַהֶפְסֵדוֹ: בְּ + הֶפְסֵד + ־וֹ — hefsed, loss (m.); 'in his loss'
קָשֵׁה: קָשֶׁה — kashe, hard, difficult (adj. ms), vocalized here with tsere; 'slow (to)'
וְקָשֵׁה: וְ + קָשֶׁה — 'and hard, and slow (to)', vocalized with tsere
לִכְעוס: כָּעַס — ka'as, to be angry (Qal inf.); 'to anger'. The vav is written without its ḥolam
בַּלְּמֵידִים: לָמִיד — lamid, learner (m. pl.), from the root of lamad; 'among learners'. The printed texts have תַּלְמִידִים
מְמַהֵר: מִהֵר — miher, to hurry (Piel participle ms); 'quick (to)'
לִשְׁמֹוַע: לִשְׁמוֹעַ — lishmoa, to hear (Qal inf.); here, to take in a teaching. Kaufmann writes a vav after the ḥolam
לְאַבֵּד: לְ + אַבֵּד — le'abed, to lose (Piel inf.); here, to forget
בַהֵפְסֵדֹו: בְּ + הֶפְסֵד + ־וֹ — 'in his loss' (vocalized with tsere, and ḥolam on the dalet)
לִשְׁמוֹע: לִשְׁמוֹעַ — 'to hear' (written without the furtive pataḥ)
לְאָבֵּד: לְ + אַבֵּד — 'to lose', vocalized with qamats
בְּנוֹתְנֵי: בְּ + נוֹתְנֵי — notnei, givers of (Qal participle construct pl. of natan); 'among givers of'
רוֹצֶה: רָצָה — ratsa, to want (Qal participle ms); 'wants'
שֶׁיִּתֵּן: שֶׁ + יִתֵּן — natan, to give (Qal impf. 3ms); 'that he give'
יִתְּנוּ: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal impf. 3mpl); אַל יִתְּנוּ, 'let (others) not give'
עֵינוֹ: עַיִן + ־וֹ — ayin, eye (f.); עֵינוֹ רָעָה, 'his eye is bad', he is grudging
בְּשֶׁלַּאֲחֵרִים: בְּ + שֶׁל + אֲחֵרִים — aḥerim, others; 'toward what belongs to others'
יִתֵּן: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal impf. 3ms); 'he will give'
בְשֶׁלּוֹ: בְּ + שֶׁל + ־וֹ — 'toward what is his own'
יִתַּן: נָתַן — 'give' (Qal impf. 3ms, vocalized yitan); אַל יִתַּן, 'let him not give'
בְּהוֹלְכֵי: בְּ + הוֹלְכֵי — holkhei, goers of (Qal participle construct pl. of halakh); 'among those who go to'
עוֹשֶׂה: עָשָׂה — asa, to do (Qal participle ms); here, to practise
בְיָדוֹ: בְּ + יָד + ־וֹ — yad, hand (f.); 'in his hand', his to keep
בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי: בְּ + יוֹשְׁבֵי — yoshvei, sitters of (Qal participle construct pl. of yashav); 'among those who sit'. A final mem after it was erased
וּמְשַׁמֶּרֶת: וּ + מְשַׁמֶּרֶת — meshameret, strainer for wine (f.); 'and strainer'
סוֹפֵג: סָפַג — safag, to soak up, absorb (Qal participle ms)
מַכְנִיס: הִכְנִיס — hikhnis, to bring in (Hifil participle ms); 'takes in'
וּמוֹצִיא: וּ + מוֹצִיא — motsi, letting out (Hifil participle ms of yatsa); 'and lets out'
בָזוֹ: בְּ + זוֹ — 'at this (end)', i.e. at the other
מוֹצִיאָה: הוֹצִיא — hotsi, to let out (Hifil participle fs); 'lets out'
וְקוֹלֶטֶת: וְ + קָלַט — kalat, to catch, retain (Qal participle fs); 'and catches'
הַשְּׁמָרִים: הַ + שְּׁמָרִים — shmarim, lees, dregs (m. pl.)
שֶׂהִיא: שֶׁ + הִיא — 'that it' (f.). Written with a sin dot, a slip for shin
הַקֶּמַח: הַ + קֶּמַח — kemaḥ, flour, meal (m.); here the powdery meal that falls through
הַסֹּלֶת: הַ + סֹּלֶת — solet, fine flour (f.); the choice part the sieve keeps
תְלוּיָיה: תָּלוּי — talui, hanging, dependent (Qal passive participle fs); תְּלוּיָה בְדָבָר, 'dependent on something'. Spelled with double yod
בְדָבָר: בְּ + דָבָר — davar, thing (m.); 'on a thing'
בָּטֵל: בָּטֵל — batel, to cease, become void (Qal pf. 3ms); 'ceases'
וּבָטֵילָה: וּ + בָּטֵל — 'and ceases' (Qal pf. 3fs, vocalized bateila)
אֵינָה: אֵין + ־ָהּ — eina, 'it (f.) is not, does not'
זה: זֶה — ze, this (m.); אֵי זֶה, 'which?'. Unvocalized in the manuscript
זו: זוֹ — zo, this (f.); 'this is'. Unvocalized in the manuscript; added in the margin by a second hand
אַהֲבַת: אַהֲבָה — ahava, love (f. construct); 'the love of'
אַמְנוֹן: אַמְנוֹן — Amnon, son of David (proper name; 2 Samuel 13)
וְתָמָר: וְ + תָמָר — Tamar, daughter of David (proper name); 'and Tamar'
וִיהוֹנָתָן: וִ + יְהוֹנָתָן — Yehonatan, Jonathan, son of Saul (proper name); 'and Jonathan'
כַּל: כָּל — kol, every, all; vocalized here with pataḥ
לְשֵם: לְ + שֵׁם — 'for the name of'; לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם, 'for the sake of Heaven'. Shin without its dot; added in the margin
וְהֶלֵּל: וְ + הִלֵּל — Helel, Hillel (proper name), vocalized with segol; 'and Hillel'
מַחֲלוֹקְתּוֹ: מַחֲלֹקֶת + ־וֹ — 'his dispute'; with שֶׁל, 'the dispute of'. The vav was added by a second hand
שֶׁלְּקֹרַח: שֶׁל + קֹרַח — Koraḥ, Korah (proper name); 'of Korah'
הַמְזַכֶּה: זִכָּה — zika, to bring merit to, lead to righteousness (Piel participle ms); 'whoever brings merit to'
הָרַבִּים: הָ + רַבִּים — rabim, the many, the public
הַמַּחֲטִיא: הֶחֱטִיא — heḥeti, to cause to sin (Hifil participle ms); 'whoever causes to sin'. The yod was added by a second hand
זָכָה: זָכָה — zakha, to be meritorious, gain merit (Qal pf. 3ms)
וְזִיכָּה: וְ + זִכָּה — 'and brought merit to' (Piel pf. 3ms)
וּזְכוּת: וּ + זְכוּת — zkhut, merit (f. construct); 'and the merit of'
תְּלוּיָה: תָּלוּי — talui, hanging, depending (Qal passive participle fs); תְּלוּיָה בוֹ, 'hangs on him, is credited to him'
צִדְקַת: צְדָקָה — tsdaka, righteousness (f. construct); 'the righteousness of'
וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו: וּ + מִשְׁפָּט + ־ָיו — mishpat, judgment, ordinance (m. pl.); 'and His judgments'
יָרָבְעָם: יָרָבְעָם — Yarov'am, Jeroboam, first king of the northern kingdom (proper name)
וְהֶחֱטִיא: וְ + הֶחֱטִיא — 'and caused to sin' (Hifil pf. 3ms)
וְחֵטְא: וְ + חֵטְא — ḥet, sin (m. construct); 'and the sin of'
חַטֹּאת: חַטָּאת — ḥatat, sin (f. pl. construct); 'the sins of'. Kaufmann spells it without the vav of the biblical חַטֹּאות
הֶחֱטִיא: הֶחֱטִיא — heḥeti, to cause to sin (Hifil pf. 3ms); 'he caused to sin'
שְׁלוֹשָה: שְׁלֹשָׁה — shlosha, three (with m. noun); spelled with vav
תַּלְמִידוֹ: תַּלְמִיד + ־וֹ — talmid, disciple (m.); תַּלְמִידוֹ שֶׁל, 'a disciple of'
שֶׁלְּבִלְעָם: שֶׁל + בִּלְעָם — Bil'am, Balaam (proper name); 'of Balaam'
וְנֶפֶשׁ: וְ + נֶפֶשׁ — nefesh, soul, appetite (f.); 'and a soul'
וְרוּחַ: וְ + רוּחַ — ruaḥ, spirit (f.); 'and a spirit'
רְחָבָה: רָחָב — raḥav, wide (adj. fs); of the soul, greedy
שלבלעם: שֶׁל + בִּלְעָם — 'of Balaam'. Unvocalized in the manuscript
מה: מָה — ma, what. Unvocalized in the manuscript
בין: בֵּין — bein, between; מַה בֵּין … לְ, 'what is the difference between … and'. Unvocalized in the manuscript
לְתַלְמִידָיו: לְ + תַלְמִידָיו — 'and his disciples' (after מַה בֵּין, lit. 'to his disciples')
יוֹרְדִים: יָרַד — yarad, to go down (Qal participle mpl); 'go down'
לְגֵיהִינָּם: לְ + גֵּיהִנֹּם — Geihinam, Gehenna, the place of punishment after death; 'to Gehenna'
תּוֹרִידֵם: הוֹרִיד + ־ֵם — horid, to bring down (Hifil impf. 2ms + 3mpl suffix); 'You will bring them down'
לִבְאֵר: לִ + בְאֵר — be'er, well, pit (f. construct); 'to the pit of'
אַנְשֵׁי: אַנְשֵׁי — anshei, men of (construct pl. of ish)
רָמִים: רָם — ram, high, haughty (m. pl.); Kaufmann's reading where the psalm has דָמִים, 'blood'
יֶחֱצוּ: חָצָה — ḥatsa, to halve (Qal impf. 3mpl); לֹא יֶחֱצוּ יְמֵיהֶם, 'will not live half their days'
אֶבְטַח: בָּטַח — bataḥ, to trust (Qal impf. 1cs); 'I will trust'
יוֹרְשִׁים: יָרַשׁ — yarash, to inherit (Qal participle mpl); 'inherit'
לְגַן: לְ + גַן — gan, garden (m. construct); גַּן עֵדֶן, 'the Garden of Eden'
לְהַנְחִיל: לְ + הַנְחִיל — hinḥil, to give as an inheritance (Hifil inf.); 'to endow'
אֹהֲבַי: אֹהֵב + ־ַי — ohavai, 'those who love Me' (Qal participle mpl + 1cs suffix). Added in the margin
יֵשׁ: יֵשׁ — yesh, 'there is'; in the verse read as a noun, 'substance'
וְאוֹצְרוֹתֵיהֶם: וְ + אוֹצָר + ־וֹתֵיהֶם — otsar, treasury (m. pl.); 'and their treasuries'
אֲמַלֵּא: מִלֵּא — mile, to fill (Piel impf. 1cs); 'I will fill'
תֵימָה: תֵּימָא — Teima, Tema (proper name); בֶּן תֵּימָא, 'son of Tema'
כַּנָּמֵר: כְּ + הַ + נָּמֵר — namer, leopard (m.); 'as the leopard'
וְקַל: וְ + קַל — kal, light, swift (adj. ms); 'and light'
כַּנֶּשֶׁר: כְּ + הַ + נֶּשֶׁר — nesher, eagle (or vulture) (m.); 'as the eagle'
וְרָץ: וְ + רָץ — rats, running (Qal participle ms of ruts); 'and swift'
כַּצְּבִי: כְּ + הַ + צְּבִי — tsvi, gazelle (m.); 'as the gazelle'
וְגִיבּוֹר: וְ + גִבּוֹר — gibor, mighty, strong (m.); 'and mighty'
כַּאֲרִי: כְּ + הָ + אֲרִי — ari, lion (m.); 'as the lion'
שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם: שֶׁ + בְּ + הַ + שָּׁמַיִם — 'who is in heaven'
עַז: עַז — az, strong (construct); עַז פָּנִים, 'strong of face', brazen
וּבוֹשׁ: וּ + בּוֹשׁ — bosh, ashamed (adj. construct); בּוֹשׁ פָּנִים, 'shamefaced'. A final tav was erased
רָצוֹן: רָצוֹן — ratson, will, favour (m.); יְהִי רָצוֹן, 'may it be (Your) will'
וא׳הֵי: וֵ + אלֹהֵי (abbr.) — ve-Elohei, 'and the God of', written וא׳הֵי
שֶׁתִּבְנֶה: שֶׁ + תִּבְנֶה — bana, to build (Qal impf. 2ms); 'that You build'
עִירָךְ: עִיר + ־ָךְ — ir, city (f.); 'Your city' (Mishnaic spelling of -kha), Jerusalem
וְתִתֵּן: וְ + תִתֵּן — natan, to give (Qal impf. 2ms); 'and that You give'
בַּגְבַּג: בַּגְבַּג — Bagbag (proper name); בֶּן בַּגְבַּג, Ben Bagbag
הֲפֹך: הָפַךְ — hafakh, to turn (Qal imperative ms); 'turn (it)'
וְהַפֵּךְ: וְ + הָפַךְ — hapekh, to turn (Piel imperative ms); 'and turn (it again)'
דְכוֹלָהּ: Aramaic: דְּ + כֹּל + ־הּ — 'for all of it'. Written over an erasure
בָךְ: Aramaic: בְּ + ־ָךְ — 'in you'. A corrected reading
וְכוֹלָּךְ: Aramaic: וְ + כֹּל + ־ָךְ — 'and all of you'. Written over an erasure
וּבַה: Aramaic: וּ + בְּ + ־הּ — 'and in it'. Added in the margin by a second hand
תְּיהוֵי: Aramaic: הֲוָא — to be (impf. 2ms, תְּהֵוֵי, here spelled with yod); 'be!'. Added in the margin by a second hand
תֵזוּעַ: Aramaic: זוּעַ — to move, budge (impf. 2ms); לָא תְּזוּעַ, 'do not move'
הֵהֵא: הֵהֵא — Hehe (proper name; the printed texts have בֶּן הֵא הֵא, Ben He He)
לְפֻס: Aramaic: לְפוּם — 'according to'. Kaufmann writes final samekh where final mem is expected
צַעְרָה: Aramaic: צַעֲרָא — tsa'ra, pain, toil (emphatic m.), spelled with final he
אַגְרָה: Aramaic: אַגְרָא — agra, wage, reward (emphatic m.), spelled with final he
שָׁנוּ: שָׁנָה — shana, to repeat; to teach (oral tradition) (Qal pf. 3mpl); 'taught'. The verb behind the word mishna
חֲכָמִים: חָכָם — ḥakham, sage, wise man (m. pl.); 'sages'
בִּלְשׁוֹן: בְּ + לָשׁוֹן — lashon, tongue, language (construct); 'in the language of'
הַמִּשְׁנָה: הַ + מִשְׁנָה — mishna, teaching learned by repetition; the Mishnah (f.)
בָּרוּךְ: בָּרוּךְ — barukh, blessed (Qal passive participle ms)
שֶׁבָּחַר: שֶׁ + בָּחַר — baḥar, to choose (Qal pf. 3ms); 'who chose'
בָּהֶם: בְּ + ־הֶם — 'them' (בָּחַר takes its object with בְּ)
וּבְמִשְׁנָתָם: וּ + בְּ + מִשְׁנָה + ־ָם — 'and their Mishnah, their teaching'
רַבִּי: רַבִּי — Rabbi, 'my master'; the title of a Tanna. Alone, as in 6:8, it means Rabbi Judah the Prince
הָעוֹסֵק: הָ + עָסַק — asak, to be busy, engage (Qal participle ms); 'who engages (in)'; עוֹסֵק בַּתּוֹרָה, 'studies Torah'
לִשְׁמָהּ: לְ + שֵׁם + ־הּ — shem, name (m.); 'for its (own) name', i.e. for its own sake
זוֹכֶה: זָכָה — zakha, to merit, earn (Qal participle ms); 'merits'
לִדְבָרִים: לִ + דְּבָרִים — 'to things'; זוֹכֶה לִדְבָרִים, 'merits things'
עוֹד: עוֹד — od, more, still; וְלֹא עוֹד אֶלָּא, 'and no more, but…' = 'what is more'
כֻּלּוֹ: כֹּל + ־וֹ — 'all of it'; הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ, 'the whole world'
כְדַי: כְּדַי — kedai, worthwhile, worth (it); 'is worth (creating) for him'
נִקְרָא: קָרָא — kara, to call (Nifal participle/pf. 3ms); 'is called'
אָהוּב: אָהַב — ahuv, beloved (Qal passive participle ms)
מְשַׂמֵּחַ: שִׂמַּח — simaḥ, to gladden (Piel participle ms); 'gives joy to'
וּמַלְבַּשְׁתּוֹ: וּ + הִלְבִּישׁ + ־וֹ — hilbish, to clothe (Hifil participle fs + 3ms suffix); 'and (the Torah) clothes him'
וְיִרְאָה: וְ + יִרְאָה — yir'a, fear, awe (f.); 'and awe' — the fear of God
וּמַכְשַׁרְתּוֹ: וּ + הִכְשִׁיר + ־וֹ — hikhshir, to make fit, prepare (Hifil participle fs + 3ms suffix); 'and makes him fit'
צַדִּיק: צַדִּיק — tsadik, righteous; a righteous man (ms)
וְחָסִיד: וְ + חָסִיד — ḥasid, devout, pious (ms); 'and devout'
וְיָשָׁר: וְ + יָשָׁר — yashar, upright, straight (ms); 'and upright'
וְנֶאֱמָן: וְ + נֶאֱמָן — ne'eman, faithful, trustworthy (Nifal participle ms); 'and faithful'
וּמְרַחַקְתּוֹ: וּ + רִחֵק + ־וֹ — riḥek, to keep far, remove (Piel participle fs + 3ms suffix); 'and keeps him far'
וּמְקָרַבְתּוֹ: וּ + קֵרֵב + ־וֹ — kerev, to bring near (Piel participle fs + 3ms suffix); 'and brings him near'
וְנֶהֱנִין: וְ + נֶהֱנָה — nehena, to benefit, enjoy (Nifal participle mpl, Mishnaic -in); 'and (people) benefit'
וְתוּשִׁיָּה: וְ + תּוּשִׁיָּה — tushiya, sound wisdom, practical skill (f.); 'and sound wisdom'
וּגְבוּרָה: וּ + גְּבוּרָה — gvura, strength, might (f.); 'and strength'
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: שֶׁ + נֶאֱמַר — ne'emar, was said (Nifal pf. 3ms); 'as it is said' — introduces a verse
וְנוֹתֶנֶת: וְ + נָתַן — notenet, giving (Qal participle fs); 'and (the Torah) gives'
וּמֶמְשָׁלָה: וּ + מֶמְשָׁלָה — memshala, dominion, rule (f.); 'and dominion'
וְחִקּוּר: וְ + חִקּוּר — ḥikur, searching out, investigation (m.); חִקּוּר דִּין, 'searching out judgment', a judge's discernment
וּמְגַלִּין: וּ + גִּלָּה — gila, to reveal (Piel participle mpl, Mishnaic -in); 'and (they) reveal'
רָזֵי: רָז — raz, secret (m. construct pl.; a Persian loanword via Aramaic); 'secrets of'
וְנַעֲשֶׂה: וְ + נַעֲשָׂה — na'asa, to become, be made (Nifal participle ms); 'and he becomes'
כְמַעְיָן: כְּ + מַעְיָן — ma'yan, spring (m.); 'like a spring'
הַמִּתְגַּבֵּר: הַ + הִתְגַּבֵּר — hitgaber, to grow stronger (Hitpael participle ms); 'that keeps gathering strength'
וּכְנָהָר: וּ + כְּ + נָהָר — nahar, river (m.); 'and like a river'
שֶׁאֵינוֹ: שֶׁ + אֵין + ־וֹ — 'that does not, that is not'
פוֹסֵק: פָּסַק — pasak, to stop, cease (Qal participle ms); 'stop'
וֶהֱוֵי: וֶ + הֱוֵי — hevei, the Mishnaic imperative 'be!' (2ms); here it continues the description: 'and he is'
וְאֶרֶךְ: וְ + אֶרֶךְ — erekh, long (construct); אֶרֶךְ רוּחַ, 'long of spirit', patient
וּמוֹחֵל: וּ + מָחַל — maḥal, to forgive, waive (Qal participle ms); 'and forgives'
עֶלְבּוֹנוֹ: עֶלְבּוֹן + ־וֹ — elbon, insult, humiliation (m.); 'the insult to him'
וּמְגַדַּלְתּוֹ: וּ + גִּדֵּל + ־וֹ — gidel, to make great (Piel participle fs + 3ms suffix); 'and makes him great'
וּמְרוֹמַמְתּוֹ: וּ + רוֹמֵם + ־וֹ — romem, to exalt (Polel participle fs + 3ms suffix); 'and raises him high'
הַמַּעֲשִׂים: הַ + מַעֲשֶׂה — ma'ase, deed, work (m. pl.); here God's works, all creation
וָיוֹם: וָ + יוֹם — 'and day'; בְּכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם, 'every single day'
בַּת: בַּת — bat, daughter (f.); בַּת קוֹל, 'daughter of a voice', a voice from heaven
יוֹצֵאת: יָצָא — yatsa, to go out (Qal participle fs); 'goes out'
חוֹרֵב: חוֹרֵב — Ḥorev, Horeb, another name for Sinai (proper name)
וּמַכְרֶזֶת: וּ + הִכְרִיז — hikhriz, to proclaim (Hifil participle fs); 'and proclaims'
וְאוֹמֶרֶת: וְ + אָמַר — omeret, saying (Qal participle fs); 'and says'
לַבְּרִיּוֹת: לְ + הַ + בְּרִיָּה — briya, creature; pl. people (f. pl.); 'to people'. לָהֶם לַבְּרִיּוֹת, 'to them, to people': the pronoun points ahead to the noun
מֵעֶלְבּוֹנָהּ: מֵ + עֶלְבּוֹן + ־הּ — 'because of the insult to it'; עֶלְבּוֹנָהּ שֶׁל תּוֹרָה, 'the insult to the Torah'
עוֹסֵק: עָסַק — osek, engaging (Qal participle ms); 'busies himself (with)'
נָזוּף: נָזַף — nazuf, rebuked, under censure (Qal passive participle ms)
בְּאַף: בְּ + אַף — af, nose, snout (m.); 'in the snout of'
וְסָרַת: וְ + סוּר — sar, to turn aside (Qal participle fs construct); סָרַת טָעַם, 'turned aside from good sense'
טָעַם: טַעַם — ta'am, taste; good sense, discretion (m.; pausal form)
וְאוֹמֵר: וְ + אָמַר — 'and it says' — introduces a further proof-text
וְהַלֻּחֹת: וְ + הַ + לוּחַ — lu'aḥ, tablet (m. pl., defective spelling); 'and the tablets'
חָרוּת: חָרַת — ḥarut, engraved (Qal passive participle ms)
הַלֻּחֹת: הַ + לוּחַ — 'the tablets' (m. pl., defective spelling)
תִּקְרָא: קָרָא — kara, to read (Qal impf. 2ms); אַל תִּקְרָא, 'do not read'
חוֹרִין: חוֹר — ḥor, free man (m. pl., Mishnaic -in); בֶּן חוֹרִין, 'a free man'
שֶׁעוֹסֵק: שֶׁ + עָסַק — 'who busies himself (with)' (Qal participle ms)
בְּתַלְמוּד: בְּ + תַּלְמוּד — talmud, study, learning (m. construct); 'in the study of'
מִתְעַלֶּה: הִתְעַלָּה — hit'ala, to rise, be raised up (Hitpael participle ms); 'rises'
וּמִמַּתָּנָה: וּ + מִ + מַתָּנָה — Mattanah, a wilderness station (Num 21:18–19); as a word, 'gift'; 'and from Mattanah'
נַחֲלִיאֵל: נַחֲלִיאֵל — Naḥali'el, Nahaliel, a wilderness station; read as נַחֲלָה + אֵל, 'God's inheritance'
בָּמוֹת: בָּמוֹת — Bamot, Bamoth, a wilderness station; as a word, 'heights, high places'
הַלּוֹמֵד: הַ + לָמַד — lamad, to learn (Qal participle ms); 'one who learns'
מֵחֲבֵרוֹ: מֵ + חָבֵר + ־וֹ — ḥaver, companion, fellow (m.); 'from his fellow'
הֲלָכָה: הֲלָכָה — halakha, a legal ruling, a law (f.)
צָרִיךְ: צָרִיךְ — tsarikh, must, needs to (adj. ms)
לִנְהוֹג: לְ + נָהַג — nahag, to conduct, practise (Qal inf.); לִנְהוֹג בּוֹ כָבוֹד, 'to treat him with honour'
מָצִינוּ: מָצָא — matsa, to find (Qal pf. 1pl, Mishnaic spelling without alef); 'we find'
בְדָוִד: בְּ + דָּוִד — 'with David, in the case of David'
מֵאֲחִיתֹפֶל: מֵ + אֲחִיתֹפֶל — Aḥitofel, Ahithophel, David's counsellor (proper name); 'from Ahithophel'
קְרָאוֹ: קָרָא + ־וֹ — kara, to call (Qal pf. 3ms + 3ms suffix); 'he called him'
אַלּוּפוֹ: אַלּוּף + ־וֹ — aluf, guide, chief; close companion (m.); 'his guide'
וּמְיֻדָּעוֹ: וּ + מְיֻדָּע + ־וֹ — meyuda, close friend, 'one well known' (Pual participle ms); 'and his close friend'
כְּעֶרְכִּי: כְּ + עֵרֶךְ + ־ִי — erekh, value, rank (m.); 'like my rank', my equal
וָחֹמֶר: וָ + חֹמֶר — ḥomer, heaviness, stringency (m.); קַל וָחֹמֶר, 'light and heavy', the argument from lesser to greater
בִּלְבַד: בִּלְבַד — bilvad, only (pointed here with pataḥ)
וְכַמָּה: וְ + כַּמָּה — 'and how much'; עַל אַחַת כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה, 'how much more so'
יִנְחָלוּ: נָחַל — naḥal, to inherit (Qal impf. 3mpl, pausal); 'shall inherit'
וּתְמִימִים: וּ + תָּמִים — tamim, wholehearted, blameless (m. pl.); 'and the wholehearted'
יִנְחֲלוּ: נָחַל — naḥal, to inherit (Qal impf. 3mpl); 'shall inherit'
תּוֹרָתִי: תּוֹרָה + ־ִי — 'my teaching'; in the baraita's reading 'My Torah'
תַּעֲזֹבוּ: עָזַב — azav, to forsake (Qal impf. 2mpl); with אַל, 'do not forsake'
דַּרְכָּהּ: דֶּרֶךְ + ־הּ — derekh, way (f.); 'its way'; דַּרְכָּהּ שֶׁל תּוֹרָה, 'the way of Torah'
פַּת: פַּת — pat, bread, a piece of bread (f.)
תֹּאכַל: אָכַל — akhal, to eat (Qal impf. 2ms); 'you shall eat'
בִּמְשׂוּרָה: בִּ + מְשׂוּרָה — mesura, a small liquid measure (f.); 'by measure'
תִשְׁתֶּה: שָׁתָה — shata, to drink (Qal impf. 2ms); 'you shall drink'
תִּישַׁן: יָשֵׁן — yashen, to sleep (Qal impf. 2ms); 'you shall sleep'
וְחַיֵּי: וְ + חַיִּים — ḥayim, life (m. pl., construct); 'and a life of'
תִּחְיֶה: חָיָה — ḥaya, to live (Qal impf. 2ms); 'you shall live'
וּבַתּוֹרָה: וּ + בְּ + הַ + תּוֹרָה — 'and in the Torah'
תְּבַקֵּשׁ: בִּקֵּשׁ — bikesh, to seek (Piel impf. 2ms); with אַל, 'do not seek'
תַּחְמֹד: חָמַד — ḥamad, to covet, desire (Qal impf. 2ms); with אַל, 'do not covet'
מִלִּמּוּדְךָ: מִ + לִמּוּד + ־ךָ — limud, learning, study (m.); 'than your learning'
תִּתְאַוֶּה: הִתְאַוָּה — hit'ava, to crave, long for (Hitpael impf. 2ms); with אַל, 'do not crave'
לְשֻׁלְחָנָם: לְ + שֻׁלְחָן + ־ָם — shulḥan, table (m.); 'for their table'; שֻׁלְחָנָם שֶׁל מְלָכִים, 'kings' table'
וְכִתְרְךָ: וְ + כֶּתֶר + ־ךָ — keter, crown (m.); 'and your crown'
מְלַאכְתְּךָ: מְלָאכָה + ־ךָ — melakha, work (f.); בַּעַל מְלַאכְתְּךָ, 'the owner of your work', your employer — God
שֶׁיְּשַׁלֵּם: שֶׁ + שִׁלֵּם — shilem, to pay (Piel impf. 3ms); 'that he will pay'
פְּעֻלָּתֶךָ: פְּעֻלָּה + ־ךָ — pe'ula, labour, work done (f.); שְׂכַר פְּעֻלָּתֶךָ, 'the wages of your labour'
נִקְנֵית: קָנָה — kana, to acquire; nikneit, is acquired (Nifal participle fs)
מַעֲלוֹת: מַעֲלָה — ma'ala, step, degree; quality, prerogative (f. pl.)
וְאֵלוּ: וְ + אֵלּוּ — 'and these'; וְאֵלוּ הֵן, 'and these are they'
בִּשְׁמִיעַת: בִּ + שְׁמִיעָה — shmi'a, hearing (f. construct); 'with the hearing of'
בַּעֲרִיכַת: בַּ + עֲרִיכָה — arikha, arranging, ordering (f. construct); עֲרִיכַת שְׂפָתַיִם, 'the ordering of the lips', clear speech
בְּשִׂכְלוּת: בְּ + שִׂכְלוּת — sikhlut, insight, intelligence (f. construct)
בְּאֵימָה: בְּ + אֵימָה — eima, dread, awe (f.); here awe before one's teacher
בְּשִׁמּוּשׁ: בְּ + שִׁמּוּשׁ — shimush, serving, attendance (m. construct); שִׁמּוּשׁ חֲכָמִים, 'attending on sages' — the disciple's apprenticeship
בְּדִקְדּוּק: בְּ + דִּקְדּוּק — dikduk, close examination, precision (m. construct); 'with careful discussion with'
חֲבֵרִים: חָבֵר — ḥaver, companion, fellow student (m. pl.)
וּבְפִלְפּוּל: וּ + בְּ + פִּלְפּוּל — pilpul, sharp debate, keen argument (m. construct); 'and with sharp debate with'
בְּיִשּׁוּב: בְּ + יִשּׁוּב — yishuv, settledness, calm deliberation (m.)
בַּמִּקְרָא: בַּ + מִקְרָא — mikra, Scripture, 'what is read' (m.)
בְּמִעוּט: בְּ + מִעוּט — mi'ut, keeping to a minimum, a little (m. construct); 'with little'
בְּאֶרֶךְ: בְּ + אֶרֶךְ — 'with length of'; אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם, 'length of anger', patience
בֶּאֱמוּנַת: בֶּ + אֱמוּנָה — emuna, faith, trust (f. construct); 'with trust in'
וּבְקַבָּלַת: וּ + בְּ + קַבָּלָה — kabala, acceptance, receiving (f. construct); 'and with the acceptance of'
הַיִּסּוּרִין: הַ + יִסּוּרִים — yisurim, sufferings, afflictions (m. pl., Mishnaic -in)
הַמַּכִּיר: הַ + הִכִּיר — hikir, to recognize, know (Hifil participle ms); 'who knows'
וְהַשָּׂמֵחַ: וְ + הַ + שָׂמֵחַ — same'aḥ, glad, happy (adj. ms); 'and who is happy'
וְהָעוֹשֶׂה: וְ + הָ + עָשָׂה — 'and who makes' (Qal participle ms)
מַחֲזִיק: הֶחֱזִיק — heḥezik, to hold (Hifil participle ms); מַחֲזִיק טוֹבָה לְעַצְמוֹ, 'holds good to himself', takes credit
הַצְּדָקוֹת: הַ + צְדָקָה — tsdaka, righteousness; righteous deeds, charity (f. pl.)
הַמֵּישָׁרִים: הַ + מֵישָׁרִים — meisharim, uprightness, fairness (m. pl.)
הַתּוֹכָחוֹת: הַ + תּוֹכָחָה — tokhaḥa, rebuke, reproof (f. pl.)
מִתְרַחֵק: הִתְרַחֵק — hitraḥek, to keep oneself far (Hitpael participle ms); 'keeps away'
מֵגִיס: הֵגִיס — hegis, to make proud, coarsen (Hifil participle ms); מֵגִיס לִבּוֹ, 'swells his heart', grows arrogant
שָׂמֵחַ: שָׂמֵחַ — same'aḥ, glad, taking pleasure (adj. ms)
בְּהוֹרָאָה: בְּ + הוֹרָאָה — hora'a, handing down legal rulings (f.)
נוֹשֵׂא: נָשָׂא — nasa, to carry (Qal participle ms); נוֹשֵׂא בְעֹל, 'carries in the yoke', shares the burden
מַכְרִיעוֹ: הִכְרִיעַ + ־וֹ — hikhri'a, to tip the scale, decide (Hifil participle ms + 3ms suffix); מַכְרִיעוֹ לְכַף זְכוּת, 'tips him toward the pan of merit', judges him favourably
מַעֲמִידוֹ: הֶעֱמִיד + ־וֹ — he'emid, to stand, set up (Hifil participle ms + 3ms suffix); 'sets him (on)'
מִתְיַשֵּׁב: הִתְיַשֵּׁב — hityashev, to settle, become calm (Hitpael participle ms); מִתְיַשֵּׁב לִבּוֹ, 'his mind is settled'
שׁוֹאֵל: שָׁאַל — sha'al, to ask (Qal participle ms); 'asks'
שׁוֹמֵעַ: שָׁמַע — shama, to hear, listen (Qal participle ms); 'listens'
וּמוֹסִיף: וּ + הוֹסִיף — hosif, to add (Hifil participle ms); 'and adds'
מְנָת: מְנָת — menat, portion; עַל מְנָת, 'in order to'
וְהַלּוֹמֵד: וְ + הַ + לָמַד — 'and one who learns' (Qal participle ms)
הַמַּחְכִּים: הַ + הֶחְכִּים — heḥkim, to make wise (Hifil participle ms); 'who makes (his teacher) wiser' — by his questions
וְהַמְכַוֵּן: וְ + הַ + כִּוֵּן — kiven, to aim, make exact (Piel participle ms); 'and who gets (his report) exactly right'
שְׁמוּעָתוֹ: שְׁמוּעָה + ־וֹ — shmu'a, a teaching heard from a teacher, report (f.); 'what he has heard'
וְהָאוֹמֵר: וְ + הָ + אָמַר — 'and who says' (Qal participle ms)
אוֹמְרוֹ: אוֹמֵר + ־וֹ — 'the one who said it' (Qal participle ms + 3ms suffix)
לָמַדְתָּ: לָמַד — lamad, to learn (Qal pf. 2ms); הָא לָמַדְתָּ, 'so you have learned'
וַתֹּאמֶר: וַ + אָמַר — amar, to say (Qal impf. 3fs with vav consecutive); 'and (she) said'
לְעֹשֶׂיהָ: לְ + עֹשֶׂה + ־יהָ — 'to those who do it' (Qal participle mpl + 3fs suffix)
וּבָעוֹלָם: וּ + בְּ + הָ + עוֹלָם — 'and in the world'
לְמֹצְאֵיהֶם: לְ + מֹצֵא + ־יהֶם — 'to those who find them' (Qal participle mpl + 3mpl suffix)
לְשָׁרֶךָ: לְ + שֹׁר + ־ךָ — shor, navel (m.); 'to your navel', i.e. your body
וְשִׁקּוּי: וְ + שִׁקּוּי — shikuy, drink, moistening (m.); 'and refreshment'
לְעַצְמוֹתֶיךָ: לְ + עֶצֶם + ־וֹתֶיךָ — etsem, bone (f. pl.); 'to your bones'
לַמַּחֲזִיקִים: לְ + הַ + הֶחֱזִיק — 'to those who hold fast' (Hifil participle mpl)
וְתֹמְכֶיהָ: וְ + תָּמַךְ + ־יהָ — tamakh, to support, hold up (Qal participle mpl + 3fs suffix); 'and those who hold it up'
מְאֻשָּׁר: אִשֵּׁר — me'ushar, made happy, fortunate (Pual participle ms)
לִוְיַת: לִוְיָה — livya, garland, wreath (f. construct); 'a garland of'
וַעֲנָקִים: וַ + עֲנָק — anak, necklace (m. pl.); 'and necklaces'
לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶיךָ: לְ + גַּרְגֶּרֶת + ־ךָ — gargeret, throat, neck (f. pl.); 'for your neck'
תִּתֵּן: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal impf. 3fs); 'it will give'
עֲטֶרֶת: עֲטָרָה — atara, crown (f. construct); 'a crown of'
תְּמַגְּנֶךָּ: מִגֵּן + ־ךָּ — migen, to bestow, present (Piel impf. 3fs + 2ms suffix); 'it will bestow on you'
יִרְבּוּ: רָבָה — rava, to increase (Qal impf. 3mpl); 'will multiply'
וְיוֹסִיפוּ: וְ + הוֹסִיף — hosif, to add (Hifil impf. 3mpl); 'and they will add'
שְׁנוֹת: שָׁנָה — shana, year (f. construct pl.); 'years of'
אֹרֶךְ: אֹרֶךְ — orekh, length (m.); אֹרֶךְ יָמִים, 'length of days', long life
בִּימִינָהּ: בְּ + יָמִין + ־הּ — yamin, right hand (f.); 'in its right hand'
בִּשְׂמֹאולָהּ: בִּ + שְׂמֹאל + ־הּ — smol, left hand (m.); 'in its left'
וּשְׁנוֹת: וּ + שָׁנָה — 'and years of' (f. construct pl.)
יוֹסִיפוּ: הוֹסִיף — hosif, to add (Hifil impf. 3mpl); 'they will add'
מִשּׁוּם: מִ + שׁוּם — 'on account of'; מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי X, 'in the name of Rabbi X'
יוֹחַאי: יוֹחַאי — Yoḥai (proper name); שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן יוֹחַאי, Simeon ben Yoḥai
וְהַזִּקְנָה: וְ + הַ + זִקְנָה — zikna, old age (f.)
וְהַשֵּׂיבָה: וְ + הַ + שֵׂיבָה — seiva, grey hair, ripe old age (f.)
וְהַבָּנִים: וְ + הַ + בֵּן — 'and children' (m. pl., literally 'sons')
תִּמָּצֵא: מָצָא — matsa, to find (Nifal impf. 3fs); 'it is found'
וַהֲדַר: וַ + הָדָר — hadar, splendour (m. construct); 'and the splendour of'
זְקֵנִים: זָקֵן — zaken, old man, elder (m. pl.); 'old men, elders'
וְחָפְרָה: וְ + חָפֵר — ḥafer, to be abashed (Qal pf. 3fs with vav consecutive); 'and (the moon) will be abashed'
וּבוֹשָׁה: וּ + בּוֹשׁ — bosh, to be ashamed (Qal pf. 3fs with vav consecutive); 'and will be ashamed'
מָלַךְ: מָלַךְ — malakh, to reign (Qal pf. 3ms); 'reigns, will reign'
ה׳: יְהוָה (abbr.) — the LORD, the divine name, written ה׳ and read Adonay
צְבָאוֹת: צָבָא — tsava, host, army (m. pl.); ה׳ צְבָאוֹת, 'the LORD of hosts'
וּבִירוּשָׁלַיִם: וּ + בִּ + יְרוּשָׁלַיִם — Yerushalayim, Jerusalem; 'and in Jerusalem'
וְנֶגֶד: וְ + נֶגֶד — neged, before, in front of; 'and before'
מְנַסְיָא: מְנַסְיָא — Menasya (proper name; an Aramaic form of Manasseh)
מִדּוֹת: מִדָּה — mida, measure; quality, trait (f. pl.)
שֶׁמָּנוּ: שֶׁ + מָנָה — mana, to count (Qal pf. 3mpl); 'that (the sages) counted'
נִתְקַיְּמוּ: קִיֵּם — nitkaymu, were fulfilled (Nitpael pf. 3mpl, the Mishnaic passive-reflexive); 'were fulfilled'
בְרַבִּי: בְּ + רַבִּי — 'in Rabbi' — Rabbi Judah the Prince
וּבְבָנָיו: וּ + בְּ + בֵּן + ־יו — 'and in his sons'
פַּעַם: פַּעַם — pa'am, time, occasion (f.); פַּעַם אַחַת, 'once'
הָיִיתִי: הָיָה — haya, to be (Qal pf. 1s); 'I was'
מְהַלֵּךְ: הִלֵּךְ — hilekh, to walk (Piel participle ms); 'walking'
וּפָגַע: וּ + פָּגַע — paga, to meet, come upon (Qal pf. 3ms); 'and (a man) met'
בִּי: בְּ + ־ִי — 'me' (פָּגַע takes its object with בְּ)
וְנָתַן: וְ + נָתַן — 'and gave'; נָתַן לִי שָׁלוֹם, 'greeted me'
וְהֶחֱזַרְתִּי: וְ + הֶחֱזִיר — heḥezir, to return, give back (Hifil pf. 1s); 'and I returned'
אָמַרְתִּי: אָמַר — amar, to say (Qal pf. 1s); 'I said'
מֵעִיר: מֵ + עִיר — ir, city (f.); 'from a city'
סוֹפְרִים: סוֹפֵר — sofer, scribe; a scholar of Scripture (m. pl.)
רְצוֹנְךָ: רָצוֹן + ־ךָ — ratson, will, wish (m.); 'is it your wish?'
שֶׁתָּדוּר: שֶׁ + דָּר — dar, to dwell (Qal impf. 2ms); 'that you dwell'
בִמְקוֹמֵנוּ: בִּ + מָקוֹם + ־נוּ — 'in our place, in our town'
אֶתֵּן: נָתַן — natan, to give (Qal impf. 1s); 'I will give'
אֲלָפִים: אֶלֶף — alafim, thousands (m. pl.); אֶלֶף אֲלָפִים, 'a thousand thousand', a million
דִּינְרֵי: דִּינָר — dinar, a coin (m. construct pl.; from Latin denarius); 'dinars of'
וַאֲבָנִים: וַ + אֶבֶן — even, stone (f. pl.); אֲבָנִים טוֹבוֹת, 'precious stones'
וּמַרְגָּלִיּוֹת: וּ + מַרְגָּלִית — margalit, pearl (f. pl.; from Greek margarites)
נוֹתֵן: נָתַן — noten, giving (Qal participle ms); 'if you give'
שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם: שֶׁ + בְּ + הָ + עוֹלָם — 'that is in the world'
שֶׁבִּשְׁעַת: שֶׁ + בִּ + שָׁעָה — sha'a, hour (f. construct); 'that at the hour of'
מְלַוִּין: לִוָּה — liva, to accompany (Piel participle mpl, Mishnaic -in); 'accompany'
לָאָדָם: לְ + הָ + אָדָם — 'the person' (object of מְלַוִּין, anticipated by לוֹ)
בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ: בְּ + הִתְהַלֵּךְ + ־ךָ — hithalekh, to walk about (Hitpael inf. + 2ms suffix); 'when you walk'
תַּנְחֶה: הִנְחָה — hinḥa, to lead, guide (Hifil impf. 3fs); 'it will guide'
בְּשָׁכְבְּךָ: בְּ + שָׁכַב + ־ךָ — shakhav, to lie down (Qal inf. + 2ms suffix); 'when you lie down'
תִּשְׁמֹר: שָׁמַר — shamar, to guard (Qal impf. 3fs); 'it will guard'; with עָלֶיךָ, 'watch over you'
וַהֲקִיצוֹתָ: וַ + הֵקִיץ — hekits, to wake (Hifil pf. 2ms with vav consecutive); 'and when you wake'
תְשִׂיחֶךָ: שִׂיחַ + ־ךָ — si'aḥ, to talk (Qal impf. 3fs + 2ms suffix); 'it will talk with you'
בַּקֶּבֶר: בַּ + קֶבֶר — kever, grave (m.); 'in the grave'
כָּתוּב: כָּתַב — katuv, written (Qal passive participle ms)
יְדֵי: יָד — yad, hand (f. dual construct); עַל יְדֵי, 'by the hands of, through'
תוֹרַת: תּוֹרָה — torah, teaching (f. construct); 'the teaching of'
מֵאַלְפֵי: מֵ + אֶלֶף — 'than thousands of' (m. pl. construct)
הַקָּדוֹשׁ: הַ + קָדוֹשׁ — kadosh, holy (adj. ms); הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, 'the Holy One, blessed be He'
הַמִּקְדָּשׁ: הַ + מִקְדָּשׁ — mikdash, sanctuary (m.); בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, 'the Temple'
מִנַּיִן: מִנַּיִן — minayin, from where? (how do we know?)
דִּכְתִיב: Aramaic: דְּ + כְּתִיב — 'for it is written'
קָנָנִי: קָנָה + ־נִי — kana, to acquire, create (Qal pf. 3ms + 1s suffix); 'acquired me'
מִפְעָלָיו: מִפְעָל + ־יו — mif'al, work, deed (m. pl.); 'His works'
הֲדֹם: הֲדֹם — hadom, footstool (m. construct); 'the stool of'
תִּבְנוּ: בָּנָה — bana, to build (Qal impf. 2mpl); 'you would build'
וְאֵי: וְ + אֵי — 'and where'; אֵי זֶה, 'which, where is'
רַבּוּ: רַב — rabu, to be many (Qal pf. 3pl); 'are many'
מָלְאָה: מָלֵא — male, to be full (Qal pf. 3fs); 'is full'
וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ: וַ + בֵּרַךְ + ־הוּ — berakh, to bless (Piel impf. 3ms with vav consecutive + 3ms suffix); 'and he blessed him'
וַיֹּאמַר: וַ + אָמַר — amar, to say (Qal impf. 3ms with vav consecutive); 'and he said'
אַבְרָם: אַבְרָם — Avram, Abram (proper name; Abraham's earlier name)
קֹנֵה: קָנָה — kone, possessor, creator (Qal participle ms construct); 'Possessor of'
יַעֲבֹר: עָבַר — avar, to pass over, cross (Qal impf. 3ms); 'until (they) pass over'
קָנִיתָ: קָנָה — kana, to acquire (Qal pf. 2ms); 'You acquired'
לִקְדוֹשִׁים: לִ + קָדוֹשׁ — 'to the holy ones' (m. pl.)
וְאַדִּירֵי: וְ + אַדִּיר — adir, mighty, noble (m. construct pl.); 'and the mighty'
לְשִׁבְתְּךָ: לְ + יָשַׁב + ־ךָ — yashav, to dwell, sit (Qal inf. + 2ms suffix); 'for Your dwelling'
פָּעַלְתָּ: פָּעַל — pa'al, to make, do (Qal pf. 2ms); 'You made'
וַיְבִיאֵם: וַ + הֵבִיא + ־ֵם — hevi, to bring (Hifil impf. 3ms with vav consecutive + 3mpl suffix); 'and He brought them'
קָדְשׁוֹ: קֹדֶשׁ + ־וֹ — kodesh, holiness (m.); גְּבוּל קָדְשׁוֹ, 'His holy territory'
שֶּׁבָּרָא: שֶׁ + בָּרָא — bara, to create (Qal pf. 3ms); 'that (He) created'
הַנִּקְרָא: הַ + קָרָא — 'who is called' (Nifal participle ms)
וְלִכְבוֹדִי: וְ + לִ + כָּבוֹד + ־ִי — 'and for My glory'
יְצַרְתִּיו: יָצַר — yatsar, to form, fashion (Qal pf. 1s + 3ms suffix); 'I formed him'
יְהֹוָה: יְהֹוָה — the LORD, the divine name (YHWH), written in full; read Adonay
יִמְלֹךְ: מָלַךְ — malakh, to reign (Qal impf. 3ms); 'will reign'
וָעֶד: וָ + עַד — ad, eternity; לְעֹלָם וָעֶד, 'for ever and ever' (pausal)
רָצָה: רָצָה — ratsa, to want, wish (Qal pf. 3ms); 'wished'
לְזַכּוֹת: לְ + זִכָּה — zika, to give merit, make worthy (Piel inf.); 'to give merit to'
הִרְבָּה: הִרְבָּה — hirba, to increase, give much (Hifil pf. 3ms); 'He gave abundantly'
וּמִצְוֹת: וּ + מִצְוָה — mitsva, commandment (f. pl.); 'and commandments'
לְמַעַן: לְמַעַן — lema'an, for the sake of
יַגְדִּיל: הִגְדִּיל — higdil, to make great (Hifil impf. 3ms); 'to make great'
וְיַאְדִּיר: וְ + הֶאְדִּיר — he'dir, to make glorious (Hifil impf. 3ms); 'and glorious'
מְתוּנִין: מָתוּן — patient, deliberate (pl.; Mishnaic plural -in); 'patient, unhurried'
מִשְּׁיָרֵי: מִ + שְׁיָרֵי — sheyarei, remnants of (construct pl. of sheyar); 'of the last of' — one of the last survivors of
סוֹכוֹ: סוֹכוֹ — Sokho, a town in Judah (proper name)
עֲשִׂיתֶם: עָשָׂה — to do (Qal pf. 2mpl); 'you had done (it)'. The shin is unpointed in the manuscript
אֶפְשָׁר: אֶפְשָׁר — possible (adv.). The shin has no vowel in the manuscript
בְּסוֹף: בְּ + סוֹף — 'in the end' (printed וְסוֹף). The bet is unpointed in the manuscript
בָשָׂר: בָּשָׂר — basar, flesh (m.); here a fat body. The shin is unpointed in the manuscript
פְּעוּלָּתָךְ: פְּעֻלָּה + ־ָךְ — pe'ula, labor, work done (f.) + 2ms suffix; 'your labor'. The lamed is unpointed in the manuscript
הִיסְתְּכֵּל: הִסְתַּכֵּל — histakel, to look at, consider (Hitpael imperative ms); 'look into, keep in view'. The tav has no vowel point in the manuscript
בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה: בְּ + שְׁלֹשָׁה — 'at three, into three'. The bet has no vowel point in the manuscript
שֶׁנִּיבְרָא: שֶׁ + נִבְרָא — 'that he was created' (Nifal pf. 3ms). The nun has no vowel point in the manuscript
וּפִיתְחֵי: וּ + פֶּתַח — petaḥ, opening (m. construct pl.); 'and the openings of'. פִּתְחֵי נִדָּה, the rules for when menstrual impurity begins. The tav has no vowel point in the manuscript
שֶׁנ׳: שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (abbr.) — 'as it is said', written שׁנ׳. The shin is unvocalized in the manuscript
תֹאכֵל: אָכַל — akhal, to eat (Qal impf. 2ms); 'you eat'. The tav is unvocalized in the manuscript
הַרְבֵּה: הַרְבֵּה — 'much'. The bet is unvocalized in the manuscript
גוֹלֶה: גָּלָה — gole, going into exile (Qal participle ms); 'exiling yourself'. The gimel is unvocalized in the manuscript
מַתְּתְיָה: מַתִּתְיָה — Mattetya (proper name; the printed editions have מַתְיָא). The second tav is unvocalized in the manuscript
בְּשָׁעָה: בְּ + שָׁעָה — 'in the hour'. The bet is unvocalized; the final he was corrected from tav
לִרְאוֹתוֹ: רָאָה + ־וֹ — 'to see him' (Qal inf. + 3ms suffix). The final vav was added by a second hand
נִיסּוּ: נִסָּה — nisa, to test, try (Piel pf. 3mpl); 'tried'. The final vav is written without its point
הַמִּקְדָּש: הַ + מִקְדָּשׁ — mikdash, sanctuary (m.); בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, 'the Temple'. The mem is unvocalized in the manuscript
לְכֹהֵן: לְ + כֹּהֵן — kohen, priest; כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל, 'the high priest'. The kaf is unvocalized in the manuscript
בְיוֹם: בְּ + יוֹם — yom, day (construct); 'on the day of'. The bet is unvocalized in the manuscript
כִיבּוּ: כִּבָּה — kiba, to put out, extinguish (Piel pf. 3mpl); 'put out'. The kaf is unvocalized in the manuscript
וְאֵילֹו: וְ + אַיִל + ־וֹ — ayil, ram (m.) + 3ms suffix; 'and the ram (of)'. The vav is a raised letter, without its point
דֶּבֶר: דֶּבֶר — dever, pestilence, plague (m.). Unvocalized in the manuscript apart from the dagesh
וּבְמוֹצָאֵי: וּ + בְּ + מוֹצָאֵי — 'and at the close of'. The bet is unvocalized in the manuscript
שֶׁיִּתְּנוּ: שֶׁ + יִתְּנוּ — 'that (others) give'. The shin is a raised letter, unvocalized
בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ: בְּ + תוֹרָה + ־ֶךָ — 'in Your Torah'. The resh is unvocalized in the manuscript
